item.title: xDSL-CCPP: An alternative code generator for atmospheric modelling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

The Common Community Physics Package (CCPP) is a framework designed to simplify the exchange of physics packages between state-of-the-art atmospheric models. A core software component of CCPP is a code generator: a bespoke Python-based application th…

The Common Community Physics Package (CCPP) is a framework designed to simplify the exchange of physics packages between state-of-the-art atmospheric models. A core software component of CCPP is a code generator: a bespoke Python-based application that uses regular expressions to transform an input specification into Fortran source code. While the code generator initially provided a simple transformation capability, the demands of state-of-the-art atmospheric models have resulted in significant increases in its complexity. Furthermore, ongoing code modernisation efforts to enable GPU-based computing have placed additional demands on the code generator for which it was never designed. Domain Specific Languages (DSLs) have proven to be highly effective in High Performance Computing (HPC), offering the ability to simplify code modernisation efforts. However, traditionally the effort and specialist skills required in the development of a DSL have been a blocker to adoption. In recent years, however, there have been great advances in compiler technologies, and frameworks such as MLIR and xDSL have the potential to greatly lower this barrier to entry. In this paper, we present xDSL-CCPP,…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefill/decode 分离（P/D）之外，把 decode 再拆成 attention/FFN 分离（AFD）增加了通信与部署约束——未来模型与加速器路线下还值不值？

方法：提出 SiliconForge 校准模型，独立变化服务分解与硬件分配；在四个模型方向、四类加速器、两种互连上对比 P/D 与 P/D+AFD，用相同流水线重叠规则与功耗预算联合优化。

关键数字：主对比显示 AFD 在 SLO goodput/kW 上无稳健的部署级优势；最大 AFD 领先来自多容纳一个 prefill 副本而非更高效的 decode 池；KV-heavy 方向在专家池横跨多个小型 scale-up 域时 AFD 名义领先。

为什么值得看：用可复现的校准模型回答「是否拆分 decode」的基础设施决策，前瞻性规划直接可用。

原文：Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators

item.title: Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：模拟 CIM 扩展到更多芯片（chiplet）时，基于局部算子成本与聚合通信的抽象掩盖了权重映射拓扑的影响——如何量化并利用这一设计维度？

方法：开发相位分析量化映射拓扑对系统性能的影响强度与映射优化可转化的延迟收益；提出 Isobar 仿真平台，集成 CIM 分解、异构执行与资源建模，经硅片实测与周期精确仿真验证。

关键数字：Gemma-7B prefill 上 Isobar 引导映射比最强基线降低通信时间 23.3%、端到端延迟 18.6%；系统级建模显示扩展到数千 die 时模拟 CIM 仍保持相对 GPU 的能效优势。

为什么值得看：首个把拓扑感知映射做成可搜索设计维度的模拟 CIM 平台，大模型部署选型有据可依。

原文：Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping

item.title: Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 直接生成可综合 HLS-C 时，多轮工具反馈与可复用 HLS 知识难以转成有效修订——如何提升端到端生成成功率？

方法：提出 MementoHLS，可执行可证伪的双记忆引导修复框架：ERCL 把跨任务 HLS 知识转为证据门控修复动作，RFL 把任务内修复历史转为轨迹证据抑制无效路径；Same-Candidate Reviewer 把解析/编译/测试台/综合结果绑定到对应候选，Single-Commit Arbiter 每轮最多提交一个候选。

关键数字：94 个 HLS-Eval 与 170 个 Bench4HLS 任务上，TB∧Synth pass@1/pass@5 从 41.7%/57.4% 提升至 58.9%/68.1%（HLS-Eval），从 15.5%/32.9% 提升至 32.4%/50.6%（Bench4HLS）。

为什么值得看：HLS 生成端到端可靠性提升显著，证据绑定机制避免错误归因，工程价值直接。

原文：Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation

item.title: Quantum Advantage in Local Certification of Graph Properties
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Local certification allows network vertices to verify global properties using certificates from an untrusted prover and communication with their neighbors. Its complexity is the maximum certificate size at any vertex. Fraigniaud et al. (ITCS 2021) in…

Local certification allows network vertices to verify global properties using certificates from an untrusted prover and communication with their neighbors. Its complexity is the maximum certificate size at any vertex. Fraigniaud et al. (ITCS 2021) introduced the distributed quantum Merlin-Arthur (dQMA) model and proved an exponential quantum advantage for distributed equality, measured in input-string length. We resolve a question of Hasegawa, Kundu, and Nishimura (PODC 2024) by establishing unconditional exponential and polynomial quantum advantages for graph properties, which depend only on network topology, with complexity measured in the number $n$ of vertices. For every fixed integer $μ\ge 1$, we construct a graph property admitting a one-round dQMA protocol with $O(μ\log n)$-qubit certificates and messages, whereas every $μ$-round distributed Merlin-Arthur (dMA) protocol requires $Ω(n/(μ\log^2 n))$-bit certificates. We also give a one-round dQMA protocol for graph symmetry, the existence of a nontrivial automorphism, with $\widetilde{O}(n^{5/3})$-qubit certificates. This yields a polynomial advantage over one-round dMA protocols, for which an $Ω(n^2)$-bit certificate lower bo…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Precision - Preserving Subtensor Inference for a 22B Joint Audio - Video Generator under a Fixed GPU Working Set
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：整块 offloading 需要每个传输块塞进 GPU 预算，大模型在固定显存下如何保持精度地推理？

方法：提出 PSI（Precision-Preserving Subtensor Inference），固定 arena 运行时：子块权重流式传输 + 中间状态独立管理，针对 BF16 LTX-2.5 22B 音视频联合 transformer；分区算子保持稠密实算术构造，并分离资源占用、传输正确性与数值保真控制。

关键数字：RTX A6000 九个匹配 prompt 下峰值内存从 8,578 降至 360 MiB；十一次 transformer 调用平均耗时 247.11→349.00 s；托管 arena 仅 80 MiB；3 GiB 显存上限下原生生成与 FLASH 路径均成功；FFN 复用降低平均块耗时 4.0%。

为什么值得看：把大模型 offload 推理压到固定 3 GiB 显存仍保精度，边缘与受限环境直接受益。

原文：Precision - Preserving Subtensor Inference for a 22B Joint Audio - Video Generator under a Fixed GPU Working Set

item.title: Post-Quantum Authentication of IoT Data on Ethereum: Signatures, the Calldata Floor, and Device-Signed Merkle Roots
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Field devices deployed today will still be producing records when quantum computers may break their signatures, so systems that anchor IoT data on blockchains need a post-quantum (PQ) authentication path now. We measure its cost on Ethereum under the…

Field devices deployed today will still be producing records when quantum computers may break their signatures, so systems that anchor IoT data on blockchains need a post-quantum (PQ) authentication path now. We measure its cost on Ethereum under the current execution rules, including the EIP-7623 calldata floor and the EIP-7825 transaction cap, and under the calldata repricing scheduled for the Glamsterdam upgrade. We combine device-side measurements of ML-DSA, Falcon, SLH-DSA, LMS and XMSS, reproduced costs of open-source Solidity verifiers, a new standard-compliant LMS/HSS verifier for SHA-256 and SHA-256/192, and complete transactions on an Osaka-rule EVM, priced with today's verifiers and with proposed precompiles. Three results stand out. Signing every record costs 8.7 times as much as ECDSA even with an ML-DSA precompile, because the calldata floor rather than verification sets the price. When each device signs a Merkle root over 100 records, a standard LMS verifier available today costs about 3,350 gas per record, against 245 gas for ECDSA in the same design, and it is unaffected by the scheduled repricing, which raises floor-bound designs by up to 1.9 times. With the propo…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：大集群算力密度上升，网络通信越来越限制系统性能；GPU 发起通信要低开销提交，但 GDR 控制面仍依赖 CPU、IBGDA 要 GPU 组装 WQE 消耗 SM 与带宽——怎么办？

方法：OpenRDMA 开源多路径可靠 RDMA 传输架构：最小 GPU doorbell（GPU 发 8 字节 token，FPGA NIC 从预配置上下文重建完整 WQE）；基于 MRC 支持逐包多路径与乱序到达，选择性重传、有序 DMA 放置与 GPU 可见标志轮询保证可靠交付；硬件-软件协同重传，NIC 管快速数据传输、CPU 管超时检测与恢复策略。

关键数字：正文给出架构与关键硬件组件描述，FPGA 原型实现进行中，尚无实测性能数字。

为什么值得看：把 WQE 装配移出 GPU、控制面留在 CPU，是 GPU 原生通信路径的务实新架构，开源可跟进。

原文：OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture

item.title: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI's Memory Challenge
item.description:
发表方：NVIDIA Blog　发布：2026-11-05　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 大模型、长上下文与 agentic 应用推高 GPU 显存压力，NVIDIA 主张以全栈协同设计（full-stack codesign）而非单纯堆 HBM 来应对。

要点 GPU HBM 是最快也最贵的一层，模型权重与 KV cache 竞争有限容量；下方 CPU 内存、本地 SSD、共享存储按更低每比特成本逐层扩展。做法是压缩须存内容、放到合适层级、并在 GPU 需要前取回；agentic 推理轨迹单请求上下文可达 300 万 token，加剧 KV cache 膨胀；更大 HBM 只有带宽搬得动才有用。

关键数字 从 Blackwell Ultra 到 Vera Rubin 平台，单 GPU HBM 容量约增 3%，而 agentic 每美元吞吐最高提升 30 倍（SemiAnalysis AgentX 口径）。

为什么值得看 解释"显存不够"为什么不是简单加 HBM 的问题，给出 AI 工厂内存/存储层级设计的第一手工程视角。

关键数字 从 Blackwell Ultra 到 Vera Rubin 平台，单 GPU HBM 容量约增 3%，而 agentic 每美元吞吐最高提升 30 倍（SemiAnalysis AgentX 口径）。

为什么值得看 解释"显存不够"为什么不是简单加 HBM 的问题，给出 AI 工厂内存/存储层级设计的第一手工程视角。

item.title: Modular Parameterized Model Checking of Threshold-Based Distributed Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

We present a novel approach for model checking fault-tolerant distributed algorithms: instead of building large, monolithic algorithm models, we propose a modular approach where the user decomposes the algorithm into modules, verifies them individual…

We present a novel approach for model checking fault-tolerant distributed algorithms: instead of building large, monolithic algorithm models, we propose a modular approach where the user decomposes the algorithm into modules, verifies them individually, and replaces them with a synchronous abstraction. To enable our technique, we introduce a new system model that combines aspects of threshold automata and global synchronization protocols. We investigate the expressiveness of our new model, and present a (bounded) model checking procedure as well as a method for checking the correctness of the abstraction step. We implemented the technique and report on promising experimental results on a case study

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Five Ways NVIDIA Co-Design Maximizes the Value of Every Byte in the AI Factory
item.description:
发表方：NVIDIA Technical Blog　发布：2026-11-05　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：AI factory 中如何让每个字节内存产生更多有用工作。

要点：五项全栈 co-design：NVFP4 4-bit 格式（E2M1+微块 FP8 scale）；Wide-EP 把专家摊到多 GPU 减少权重冗余；Dynamo 把 KV cache 当全舰队资源（KV-aware 路由、P/D 分离、KVCR 分层）；Vera CPU 用大内存暂存工具调用间隙的空闲上下文；CMX 提供 pod 级 KV 专用存储层。

关键数字：NVFP4 权重体积约为 FP16 的 1/3.5、FP8 的 1/1.8，KV cache 减 50%、最高 4× FP8 吞吐；Vera Rubin NVL72 每兆瓦吞吐最高达 GB300 NVL72 的 30×（同为 288GB/GPU）；Vera CPU 单核 14 GB/s、1.5TB LPDDR5X、NVLink-C2C 1.8TB/s；CMX 最高 5× tokens/s 与 5× 能效。

为什么值得看：英伟达把「每字节价值」当作系统设计主轴，整机柜推理架构的风向标。

原文：Five Ways NVIDIA Co-Design Maximizes the Value of Every Byte in the AI Factory

item.title: Characterizing CUDA Locality Domains on Blackwell GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Blackwell/Rubin 多 die 扩展下跨 die 通信与数据放置的延迟代价尚不清楚——CUDA 13.4 的 Locality Domain（LD）能否缓解？

方法：单节点 8 张 B300 上系统评测 LD 三方面：内存管理与访问、计算、通信；做 die 感知适配并集成常用库与工具。

关键数字：NCCL 2.32.3（AllGather）提速最高 43.5%、nvbandwidth（DtoD）111.3%、DeepGEMM（EP）37%；超过 32MB 分配有不可忽略的 LD 分配开销（barrier 与 TLB 失效），已向 NVIDIA 提交驱动修复，开销可降 7x–10x 且无需用户改代码。

为什么值得看：首份 Blackwell LD 特性实测报告，既给提速路径也指出分配开销与修复方案。

原文：Characterizing CUDA Locality Domains on Blackwell GPUs

item.title: A Synchronized Tri-Modality Wireless System for Multi-Point Non-Contact Cardiac Monitoring
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Cardiac physiological monitoring is fundamental to evaluating cardiovascular health and diagnosing related diseases. Non-contact radar sensing can capture chest-wall vibrations with spatial specificity, enabling localized physiological monitoring and…

Cardiac physiological monitoring is fundamental to evaluating cardiovascular health and diagnosing related diseases. Non-contact radar sensing can capture chest-wall vibrations with spatial specificity, enabling localized physiological monitoring and cardiac assessment. Progress, however, has been limited by the absence of a reliable, research-grade hardware platform for rigorous validation of radar-based methods. Prior systems typically pair radar, namely Doppler cardiography (DCG), with only electrocardiography (ECG) or other coarse references, providing no direct mechanical ground truth and thus constraining fine-grained evaluation of radar outputs. We present a tri-modality wireless system that integrates ECG, seismocardiography (SCG), and DCG under a unified acquisition and control framework for time-aligned recording and analysis. The tri-modality system combines miniaturized wearable ECG/SCG modules with a high-resolution mmWave radar module, supporting spatially resolved sensing and subsequent feature extraction. To our knowledge, this is the first integrated ECG--SCG--DCG hardware system for comprehensive cardiac monitoring; it enables multi-point thoracic acquisition, ach…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: vLLM Delivers Day-0 Support for Kimi K3.1 Pro
item.description:
发表方：vLLM Blog　发布：2026-11-04　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：vLLM 如何在 day-0 支撑 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的稀疏注意力。

要点：K3.1 Pro 是 2.8T 参数（104B active）多模态 MoE、1M token 上下文，全部 24 个 MLA 层加 DSA 稀疏注意力（indexer 每 token 打分、保留 top-2048 再做精确 MLA）。vLLM 用按块打包的单一 KV cache 容纳 MLA latent、indexer keys 与 KDA 状态；prefill 按 token 切分而非按 head；decode 上下文并行（DCP）配精确 top-k 合并。

关键数字：长上下文 decode 每层读约 23% 的 dense MLA 字节（132B index key vs 576B latent）；token-sharded prefill 在 340K tokens 上 TTFT 快 1.69×；DCP8 KV 容量 21.8M tokens vs TP8 3.04M；AgentX 最高 375.9 tok/s/用户（GB300）、815.6（Rubin）。

为什么值得看：稀疏注意力时代的 serving 系统设计范本，KV 缓存与并行策略均可迁移。

原文：vLLM Delivers Day-0 Support for Kimi K3.1 Pro

item.title: vExpert: Virtualizing Expert Storage for Adaptive Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 模型分布式部署中，静态专家放置与动态路由冲突导致严重负载不均衡；主机 DRAM 卸载可缓解，但现有 offloading 工作忽视运行期 H2D 传输与共享 PCIe 拓扑的耦合影响、以及 DRAM 大规模使用的系统级内存开销。

方法：提出 vExpert，把 DRAM 卸载从部分驻留转向全冗余的虚拟化专家存储：首个联合刻画 H2D 延迟、PCIe 争用与负载不均衡的系统性能模型；轻量分配器在运行期把物理专家动态映射到虚拟槽位；分离式管理器降低多进程环境内存开销。

关键数字：DeepSeek-V3.1 在 8 节点 H100 集群上，负载均衡比最多提升 55%，端到端加速 1.2x。

为什么值得看：直面分布式 MoE 推理的负载失衡痛点，用虚拟化专家存储给出系统性解法，落地数字扎实。

原文：vExpert: Virtualizing Expert Storage for Adaptive Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference

item.title: flash-comm: Self-Synchronizing Collective Communication for LLM Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 解码的集体通信中，就绪同步与数据搬运分离导致额外屏障开销——能否把两者融合，让数据块自带就绪证据、免去跨 GPU 屏障？

方法：提出 flash-comm：自同步传输让每个数据块携带就绪证据，接收方直接校验所需块；基于代价的协议选择器按消息大小与 GPU 数适配就绪编码；并把传输顺序与归约顺序解耦，保证异步到达下跨 GPU 结果一致。

关键数字：八卡 NVIDIA B300 上 all-reduce 延迟中位降 28.8%、最高 43.7%（对比 SOTA 的 custom AR v2）；端到端解码每输出 token 时间（TPOT）降 1.7%~6.8%；all-gather 延迟中位降 23.8%、最高 58.9%。

为什么值得看：all-reduce 占基线解码时间 11.4%，flash-comm 把该部分优化到接近理论上限，并给出独立 all-gather 收益，通信库设计值得借鉴。

原文：flash-comm: Self-Synchronizing Collective Communication for LLM Decoding

item.title: Who Pays for the Knowledge Models Copy? Model Collapse as Rogers' Paradox
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Generative models trained on the output of earlier models lose knowledge across generations, rare knowledge first. The remedies that work all bring in information from outside the

Generative models trained on the output of earlier models lose knowledge across generations, rare knowledge first. The remedies that work all bring in information from outside the loop, and the theory of model collapse treats that supply as given: a fixed archive, drawn from a fixed distribution. We argue that the supply is the problem, and that cultural evolution has the theory of it. We read model collapse as Rogers' paradox: a population that comes to rely on copying ends up no better off than one that never copied, because copies go stale unless someone keeps learning for themselves. We test the identification in three steps. First, Rogers' model, fitted only to fully synthetic training, predicts to within a few percentage points how much rare knowledge language models, from word trigrams to a pretrained transformer, retain under other mixtures of fresh data. Second, when the world itself changes, a lineage that copies its own past needs more fresh data to keep up the faster the world changes, as Rogers' model says it must and as analyses that assume a fixed target cannot; a lineage that restarts every generation from fixed pretrained weights is largely insulated, because those…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from r

Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from reading the screen or from choosing actions over a long sequence. We examine these problems in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent through separate perception checks and primitive-policy reinforcement-learning studies. In the policy study, which uses textual boards to remove image transcription from the decision interface, completion on eight held-out mazes increased from 0% before this optimization to 80.2% at a selected checkpoint, with three extra lives. The perception checks show that accurate static screenshot reading can coexist with errors during interaction. A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. The study provides empirical lessons for improving future agent training and evaluation.

A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. item.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampl

While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Weaver: Unlocking Blockchain Transaction Parallelism through State-Decoupled Symbolic Execution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Transaction execution remains a major performance bottleneck in blockchains. Existing parallel execution engines are still blocked by slow state accesses on each transaction's crit

Transaction execution remains a major performance bottleneck in blockchains. Existing parallel execution engines are still blocked by slow state accesses on each transaction's critical path, creating a hidden loss of parallelism. This paper presents Weaver, a state-decoupled transaction processing paradigm that enables execution flow to proceed in the absence of concrete state values. Weaver represents states as lightweight symbolic references and records subsequent computation as symbolic expressions while concrete values are fetched on the fly. To handle state-dependent control flow, Weaver predicts the most likely branch direction through hierarchical symbolic pattern matching. Weaver further introduces expression-granular scheduling that evaluates each symbolic expression as soon as its state dependencies are resolved, rather than waiting for the transaction's entire read set, fully exploiting fine-grained intra-transaction parallelism. Evaluation on real Ethereum blocks and synthetic workloads spanning four representative dApps shows that Weaver delivers 41%-63% higher throughput than state-of-the-art parallel execution engines and up to 7.5 times the throughput of serial exec…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Understanding the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored

Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored. We study CoT as compositional OOD generalization: the target task lacks complete reasoning trajectories or direct input-output pairs, while training provides only in-distribution (ID) atomic step data. We show that CoT generalizes by repeatedly applying a shared single-step predictor to compose reusable ID transitions. Theoretically, let $T$ denote the number of reasoning steps in the target task, $n$ the number of training samples per sub-task, and $k$ the number of output tokens per step; then the OOD task risk is controlled by the sum of the ID sub-task risks, scaled by a coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$ that is independent of $T$, although the summed risk itself may still grow with $T$. A Rademacher-complexity analysis further shows that the estimation term is of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T/n})$, rather than linear in $T$, due to predictor sharing under a uniform capacity control on the shared class. For autoregressive Next-Token Prediction, the final-task risk is bounded by the best-in-class st…

item.title: The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LoRA 用紧凑学习更新适配冻结语言模型，但 adapter 的 rank、参数量或数值重建误差都不能直接说明「保持已习得行为需要多少比特」——如何定义微调所需的有用信息量？

方法：定义可操作的 behavioral rate R*：压缩 adapter 重载回冻结基座模型后仍保留固定比例微调收益的最小序列化大小；在 LoRA 微调实验中跨数据集、跨基座模型测量，并用数据上测得的 correction spectra 排名。

关键数字：故意损坏数据集训练的 adapter 远低于冻结模型，压缩后反超（GSM8K 上 23.7%~82.9%，对比冻结 Qwen2.5-7B 的 77.6%）；压缩后的损坏 adapter 在更难数学上保留基座 97% 准确率，干净微调仅 44%。

为什么值得看：压缩不仅是体积优化，还有过滤损坏的噪声抑制效应，且微调可压缩性是「数据集-接收者」配对属性——对微调与压缩研究都是新视角。

原文：The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information

item.title: Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure

Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequence…

item.title: TauLang: A Language and Compiler for Space-Time Programming on Statically Scheduled Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Groq TSP 这类静态调度加速器去掉了缓存、仲裁器与硬件调度器，编译器必须固定每个操作的精确 slice 与发射周期——「何时运行」成为正确性条件，现有 kernel 语言无法表达显式时间，如何编程这类机器？

方法：提出 TauLang，把时间作为程序的一等公民：程序员用参数化显式时间调度操作、循环与组合 kernel；在定时中间表示 TauIR 中代数校验显式时间，再用整数线性规划联合求解张量放置与周期调度，用显式时间把相连操作分组为 timing cluster 剪枝搜索空间。

关键数字：在 TSP 类机器的周期精确模型上，联合搜索对十个 kernel 相对空间优先流程取得 1.40x 延迟加速；少量显式时间钉住即可把延迟控制在无定时调度一个周期内，并把联合搜索扩展到 1,636 个 GEMM 块（无定时搜索在 32 块即无解）。

为什么值得看：把时间显式化进语言与编译器，为静态调度加速器提供了首个可编程路径，值得关注。

原文：TauLang: A Language and Compiler for Space-Time Programming on Statically Scheduled Accelerators

item.title: Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention 等门控 delta 线性注意力层为 GPU 调优（小 tensor-core tile + 快速向量寄存器），直接移植到 TPU 会让每个矩阵 tile 空一半、瓶颈卡在向量运算——如何围绕 TPU 的 256x256 脉动矩阵单元重构？

方法：提出 Systolic Linear Attention（SLA）：把 key 加宽到 256 配分组 value head、把衰减门分组为四个 64 通道 tile、用块矩阵乘积在单个融合 kernel 内完成 chunk solve，把整个层重塑到矩阵单元上。

关键数字：TPU v7x 上完整 SLA-R4 层比开源 Tokamax KDA kernel 快 1.6x~2.5x（精确 chunk 求逆时 1.4x~2.4x）；2048 芯片 v7x 预训练研究中 6.5B~63.1B 稀疏 MoE 模型训练快 11%~24%，困惑度相当或略低。

为什么值得看：为 TPU 定制线性注意力的软硬协同设计，直接给出训练侧提速证据，对 TPU 用户有实操价值。

原文：Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs

item.title: Symmetry Breaking at the Edge of Stability via Central Flow Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Continuous symmetries in neural networks lead to conserved quantities that are invariant under gradient flow, such as layer balancedness in linear and ReLU networks. Finite-step gr

Continuous symmetries in neural networks lead to conserved quantities that are invariant under gradient flow, such as layer balancedness in linear and ReLU networks. Finite-step gradient descent need not preserve these laws, particularly at the edge of stability (EOS), where the iterates oscillate around a smoother trajectory, which can be described by the central flow dynamics (Cohen et al., 2025). We study how gradient flow conservation laws evolve under the central flow description of this regime. We show that the curvature correction induces a finite-dimensional drift determined by the oscillation covariance along critical parameter directions. We thus take the first steps to analyse which conservation laws remain and are broken at the EOS according to the central flow dynamics by analysing a scalar two-layer model, two-layer matrix factorisation, and a two-layer ReLU network, where the known conservation laws are shown to be complete (Marcotte et al., 2023).

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Short-Term Forecasting of Heterogeneous Wind Power Fleets: Global Temporal Fusion Transformer Leveraging Static Covariates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is critical for grid stability and electricity trading. While transformer-based deep learning is state of the art, industry practice reli

Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is critical for grid stability and electricity trading. While transformer-based deep learning is state of the art, industry practice relies mostly on local models trained for individual assets. This study investigates whether a global temporal fusion transformer (TFT), trained jointly on a heterogeneous portfolio of wind farms across Germany, outperforms site-specific local models in 48-hour-ahead forecasting. Using numerical weather prediction (NWP) data from the regional ICON-D2 and the global ECMWF HRES models, we compare the global TFT against local models and a linear regression baseline. The global model leverages static covariates, such as farm age, altitude above sea level, hub height, rotor diameter and power curve parameters, to learn shared representations across sites. We evaluate on 100 synthetic wind farm profiles and a real portfolio of 11 German wind farms, across two seasonal test periods with intermediate retraining. The global TFT outperforms the local models for 87% of the synthetic and 77% of the real wind farms and clearly surpasses the linear baseline. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm that these gains are significa…

item.title: Separation Is a Riesz Energy: How Many Environments Does ICA Need?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Can independent components be recovered when all of them are Gaussian? Yes, if their variances change across environments; but how many environments, and how many samples as the nu

Can independent components be recovered when all of them are Gaussian? Yes, if their variances change across environments; but how many environments, and how many samples as the number of components $d$ grows? We answer both for the joint diagonalization of $K$ covariances. Each component has a signature, its variances across the environments. Separating component $j$ costs the Riesz 2-energy $E_j$ of this signature, a sum, over the other components, of inverse pairwise Fisher informations. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defe

Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. item.title: Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic a

RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $κ$, together with an effective counterpart $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps. Motivated by this view, we introduce reward budgeting, a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt. For binary rewards and independent on-policy rollouts, its unclipped score-function estimator follows the gradient of an exact finite-$G$ concave objective with diminishing returns, while its advantage gap decreases as more rollouts become correct. For general rewards, a shifted log-mean interpretation holds asymptotically under the stated regularity conditions. These results motivate, rather than establish exact objective equivalence for, the clipped implementations. On Qwen3-8B and Llama3…

item.title: Polymorphic Inference: Tuned for your model, your traffic, your chips
item.description:
发表方：Together AI　发布：2026-11-04　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：Together AI 提出 polymorphic inference 范式：模型、流量与硬件都在变，推理部署也应随之自动调优；静态推理只为一模型、一芯片、一类流量手工调优，需要数周专家时间，且配置随流量漂移失效。

要点：Together Compiler 是其在产线的第一步：一组 agent 提出 kernel 改动，持久引擎逐个对速度与正确性（对照 stock 引擎）测试，只有验证通过的改动上线，实现持续编译；优化按 Tiered Persistent Engine 热重载迭代，获胜 kernel 与推理进入共享注册表，下一个模型或芯片从先前经验起步而非从零开始。

关键数字：单模型 24 小时编译（每模型仅两节点）；相同每用户速度下每 GPU token 数最高 2.6x（B200 上）；GLM 5.3 在 AMD MI355X 最高 3.7x，MiniMax M3 在 Trainium2 最高 2.7x；H100/B200 上各输出长度均快于专家手写 megakernel 与 ML 编译器，最高 2.5x。

为什么值得看：把「agent 夜间调优 + 持久引擎校验」落成生产服务，是持续编译路线的代表性工业实践。

原文：Polymorphic Inference: Tuned for your model, your traffic, your chips

item.title: Phantom: Temporal Caching for Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：扩散模型是高质量图像生成的主流范式，但跨数十时间步的迭代推理计算开销大；既有加速器靠差分量化或输出稀疏性，却带来内存足迹增加、设计复杂与图像退化——能否用时间缓存干净地加速？

方法：提出 Phantom 算法-架构协同设计：把时间相似性看作差分稀疏性，相邻时间步间只有少量异常 token 显著变化；Phantom 只重算这些异常 token，其余从时间缓存复用；在全局缓冲加轻量 Phantom Engine 检测异常并更新缓存，用浓缩流水线把稀疏更新映射到稠密脉动计算。

关键数字：在主流扩散模型上平均 4.0x 加速、5.5x 能耗节省（相对 GPU 与既有加速器），生成质量保持不变。

为什么值得看：用标准脉动阵列 + 轻量附加即可兑现时间冗余，是扩散推理加速里少见的保质量方案。

原文：Phantom: Temporal Caching for Diffusion Models

item.title: Performance Portability of Out-of-Kernel Optimizations on GPUs: A Molecular Docking Case Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Achieving performance portability is challenging for irregular scientific applications built as repeated multi-kernel GPU pipelines, because throughput depends on out-of-kernel dec

Achieving performance portability is challenging for irregular scientific applications built as repeated multi-kernel GPU pipelines, because throughput depends on out-of-kernel decisions as much as on kernel efficiency. Using molecular docking as a representative case study, we propose an out-of-kernel tuning methodology that treats batching policy, worker concurrency, and per-worker memory allocation as explicit optimization parameters, replacing backend-dependent occupancy-driven choices with a more portable execution strategy based on explicit resource bounds. We implement this methodology in the muDock mini-app under a manager/worker execution model where multiple host workers share a GPU through independent streams. We then evaluate the methodology on NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs across CUDA, HIP, and SYCL implementations. Across all evaluated platform/backend pairs, the memory-bounded formulation exceeds the peak throughput of the occupancy-guided baseline. The fully tuned methodology improves the end-to-end throughput on all tested configurations, achieving an average speedup of 1.53x over the baseline.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Pathwise-Budgeted LLM Routing: Online Allocation with K-Bit Tail-Cost Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Firms using large language models under fixed budgets must decide which model to call and whether to retry a failed task. Because a call's charge is revealed only after completion,

Firms using large language models under fixed budgets must decide which model to call and whether to retry a failed task. Because a call's charge is revealed only after completion, one long response can exhaust the remaining budget and leave later tasks unserved. Our objective is to maximize the number of tasks solved before service stops. We develop a contextual bandit policy, ADP-HT, which learns each model's task-specific success probability and constructs conservative cost estimates from coarsened response-length labels on a quantile grid with $2^K$ intervals. The policy weighs predicted success against these costs, adjusting the cost penalty to realized spending and the budget available per remaining task. Under calibration, local regularity, and grid-coverage conditions, we bound the excess allowance in the policy's conservative cost estimates. At a fixed sample size, increasing $K$ reduces the discretization term but increases the estimation allowance. At the tightest tested budgets, ADP-HT solves more than twice as many MATH500 and GPQA tasks as the best implemented baseline. It achieves the highest mean cumulative score at ten of fourteen RouterBench budgets. On LiveCodeBe…

item.title: Optimal Subcubic Byzantine Agreement with Plain PKI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

We consider Byzantine Agreement (BA), where $n$ parties run a distributed protocol to agree on a common value, despite $t$ parties being byzantine. In the synchronous setting, a ch

We consider Byzantine Agreement (BA), where $n$ parties run a distributed protocol to agree on a common value, despite $t$ parties being byzantine. In the synchronous setting, a choice must be made between the weaker unauthenticated setting, which only allows $t < n/3$ byzantine parties, and the stronger authenticated setting that allows up to $t < n/2$ byzantine parties. For this latter setting, BA can be solved with optimal resiliency and optimal bit complexity. However, so far, all optimal solutions rely on the use of threshold signatures. This shows a gap compared to regular signatures, where only protocols with cubic complexity are known for optimal resiliency $t < n/2$. We wonder whether this cubic complexity is required without the use of threshold signatures and show that this is not the case. More specifically, given $κ$ an upper bound on the size of a hash or signature, we describe a deterministic protocol solving BA with bit complexity $\mathcal{O}(κ^{(\sqrt{13} - 1)/2} n^{(\sqrt{13} + 1)/2}) \approx \mathcal{O}(κ^{1.303}n^{2.303})$ while having optimal resiliency $t<n/2$ and round complexity $\mathcal{O}(n)$.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Nowcasting Future Performance for Population Pruning in Survival-of-the-Fittest Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Training high-performing neural networks often involves evaluating populations of candidate models with varying hyperparameters, architectures, or random seeds. Training every cand

Training high-performing neural networks often involves evaluating populations of candidate models with varying hyperparameters, architectures, or random seeds. Training every candidate to completion is computationally expensive, yet stopping seemingly weaker runs early risks discarding models that would ultimately perform better, as learning curves can cross. To address this challenge, we investigate whether intermediate training checkpoints can predict future model accuracy and enable more informed pruning decisions. Our nowcasters predict test accuracy five epochs ahead or at the end of training. They are trained with accuracy and loss histories, weight statistics, and SANE representations as inputs. SANE is a transformer autoencoder that encodes a checkpoint as a sequence of latent tokens. We then use the nowcasters in Survival-of-the-Fittest (SOTF) training. SOTF repeatedly ranks runs during training by predicted accuracy and stops the lowest-ranked ones. Our results show that weight statistics work best for five-epoch forecasts, and SANE representations work best for final accuracy prediction. For evaluation, we compare SOTF with pruning the population by current accuracy. In…

item.title: Not All Loops Cost the Same: Phase-Dependent Depth for Serving Looped Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Looped transformer 靠共享核心反复计算扩展推理时深度，但用统一循环预算服务 prefill 与解码会耦合两者成本——能否按阶段分别配深度？

方法：LoopDuet 无训练服务方案，联合选择两个预算并保持解码深度到 prefill 边界；vLLM 实现把需要继续循环的 token 收进紧凑批次；运行时队列年龄控制器随需求调整 prefill 深度。

关键数字：HotpotQA + 单卡 A100-80GB 上，Huginn 相对最快满足同等精度的均匀设置多 19% 吞吐；更高吞吐工作点在均匀深度 8 的 97% 吞吐下多 6.04 EM 点；两条 OLMo 到达轨迹下自适应 prefill 在 100% 达成 1 秒 TTFT 目标时多 0.92–1.35 EM。

为什么值得看：把循环深度从「统一预算」改成「分阶段联合配置」，质量-吞吐权衡与负载下质量都明显改善。

原文：Not All Loops Cost the Same: Phase-Dependent Depth for Serving Looped Transformers

为什么值得看：把循环深度从「统一预算」改成「分阶段联合配置」，质量-吞吐权衡与负载下质量都明显改善。

item.title: Neural Stochastic Forecasting for Lateral Molecular Diffusion Simulations

Predicting the long-time diffusion of membrane proteins is challenging because molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are computationally expensive, while experimental single-particle

Predicting the long-time diffusion of membrane proteins is challenging because molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are computationally expensive, while experimental single-particle tracking is often limited by finite observation times. Here, we introduce a neural stochastic (NS) model for forecasting the collective diffusion of membrane proteins from coarse-grained MD trajectories. The model combines a transformer-based representation of protein configurations, recurrent networks operating at multiple temporal scales, and a stochastic latent process with learned memory. A cross-attention decoder then generates correlated protein displacements while accounting for the instantaneous system geometry and periodic boundary conditions. We evaluate the model in two membrane systems: seven interacting PIEZO channels and a mixed system containing seven PIEZO and ten TREK channels. For the seven PIEZO system, the NS model reproduces the anomalous diffusion exponent measured in MD simulations $α\sim 1$, substantially improving on a previously developed variational autoregressive model that exhibits superdiffusive behavior. item.title: NUMA-Torch: Compiler-Driven NUMA-Aware LLM Prefill on Multi-Socket CPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：多插槽 CPU 上大模型 prefill 吞吐常受 DRAM 带宽而非峰值浮点限制；TorchInductor 标准编译不考虑 NUMA 拓扑，权重访问跨插槽互联严重损耗有效带宽——能否在编译器层解决？

方法：把每个 NUMA socket 视为独立张量并行分区，提出 NUMA 感知张量并行（NUMA-TP）：透明地把权重跨 socket 分片、用 CPU affinity 让线程池与内存分配严格留在本 socket。

关键数字：双插槽 Haswell 最高 2.63x、双插槽 Cascade Lake 最高 1.87x、四插槽 Haswell-EX 最高 2.27x prefill 加速（GPT-2 117M/345M/762M、BERT Small/Large、Gemma 3 270M）。

为什么值得看：不改模型不改硬件，编译器级数据局部性修复带来数倍 prefill 提升，CPU 推理部署直接受益。

原文：NUMA-Torch: Compiler-Driven NUMA-Aware LLM Prefill on Multi-Socket CPUs

item.title: MIGONet: a multiple-input graph neural operator with solver-free discrete manufactured-solution training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Surrogate modeling of transport requires operators that capture the combined influence of spatially distributed sources and Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions, together with

Surrogate modeling of transport requires operators that capture the combined influence of spatially distributed sources and Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions, together with training datasets that can be generated at low computational cost. This work presents MIGONet, a multiple-input graph neural operator, and a discrete method of manufactured solutions (MMS) that trains it without solving a partial differential equation, using steady heat conduction as the model problem. In the discrete MMS procedure, temperature fields are prescribed a priori, and the source terms and Dirichlet or Neumann boundary data are evaluated with the same discrete operators as the reference finite-difference method (FDM), so every training sample satisfies the discrete governing equations by construction. Because the boundary data are derived from each field, a Dirichlet or Neumann condition can be assigned to every boundary segment of every sample, and the boundary specification becomes an operator input. item.title: Learning From Static Context in Federated Time Series Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Time series forecasting is shifting from locally trained, per-series models to global models trained across many heterogeneous series, which requires learning what sets the series

Time series forecasting is shifting from locally trained, per-series models to global models trained across many heterogeneous series, which requires learning what sets the series apart. When the raw data cannot be centralized, such a global model is trained with federated learning (FL), one client per data owner. State-of-the-art forecasters such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) tell series apart through a static input that describes each series and does not change over time. In the special case of a federated setting where each client holds a single series, this static input is constant within each client and varies only across clients. We ask whether a federated TFT can learn from it. Per-batch FedAdam, which aggregates gradients after every batch, uses the static input almost as well as central training, whereas communication-efficient schemes with local epochs (FedAvg, FedAdam+Prox) extract far less from it and gain nothing significant on either application dataset. At the same local computation, an Adam-compatible SCAFFOLD keeps the static pathway responsive on wind power and gains significantly there. On building energy its error still drops, but the static pathway f…

item.title: Hardwired Distributed Processing Units for Inference: Neural Decisions at the Sensor that Free the Host
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：能否把神经网络决策直接做在传感器上，把推理从宿主 CPU 上完全移除——用硬连线分布式处理单元（HDPU）在低成本 FPGA 上完成端到端检测？

方法：为斑马线检测构建 HDPU：80x60 像素流水线接四层二值 CNN（93,408 个一位权重），在 Artix-7 FPGA 上逐帧决策，从 Python 模型经 RTL 仿真到板卡逐位验证；无处理器、无操作系统、无全分辨率帧存储。

关键数字：每帧固定 2,269,477 时钟周期（34.04ms），落在 37.49ms 帧周期内；全部 639 张测试图与位精确软件模型结果一致；整条检测路径仅 1,814 LUT；回答时正确率 95.7%，对比度级把行车记录仪类帧从 47.7% 提到 78.2%；宿主每帧只收 16 字节（原 614,400，少 38,400 倍）。

为什么值得看：把「决策本身」搬到传感器端而非仅预处理，为边缘推理的极低功耗形态提供完整参考。

原文：Hardwired Distributed Processing Units for Inference: Neural Decisions at the Sensor that Free the Host

item.title: GPUMAP: GPU-Accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques are fundamental to the analysis of high-dimensional data, yet their substantial computational cost limits their use in interactive settings

Dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques are fundamental to the analysis of high-dimensional data, yet their substantial computational cost limits their use in interactive settings. To address this limitation, we present GPU-accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (GPUMAP), an efficient progressive DR algorithm designed for interactive use. We identify three atomic operations within UMAP and restructure them into a progressive pipeline. As part of this adaptation, we introduce modifications to UMAP, including operation queues, instance-wise local join, and scheduling strategies. We further accelerate computation by leveraging GPU parallelism, enabling interactive analysis of million-scale datasets on commodity GPU hardware. Finally, we employ our implementation to systematically study the behavior of progressive DR, investigating how projections evolve over time relative to the ground-truth projection and how biased data streams influence the quality and stability of the resulting projections.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Fingerprinting the Dispatchers behind Distributed Model Extraction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

API distillation campaigns try to hide model-stealing traffic by splitting requests across thousands of load-balanced accounts, which standard content classifiers often miss. Howev

API distillation campaigns try to hide model-stealing traffic by splitting requests across thousands of load-balanced accounts, which standard content classifiers often miss. However, request timestamps, specifically arrival time and stream completion time, reveal the underlying dispatching strategy, such as round-robin counters or key-shuffling pools. Using a 20 percent seed set, this timing analysis can forensically rank the remaining accounts of a campaign with 0.92 to 1.00 AUC within 20 minutes, even across thousands of real production accounts. While adaptive attackers struggle to hide rotating dispatchers using jitter, pinning keys successfully evades detection, though it can severely throttle throughput when quotas bind. Ultimately, timing exposes shared infrastructure patterns even when content filters fail.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FaCoDiff: Factor-Correlated Diffusion for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Multivariate probabilistic forecasting requires modeling cross-variable dependence alongside marginal uncertainty. The challenge is to learn this dependence while controlling margi

Multivariate probabilistic forecasting requires modeling cross-variable dependence alongside marginal uncertainty. The challenge is to learn this dependence while controlling marginal noise scales and avoiding dense covariance costs. We propose Factor-Correlated Diffusion (FaCoDiff), which couples a compact conditional statistical estimator with structured denoising. History-conditioned factor loadings use distinct coefficients for forecast-center correction, scale adjustment and noise dependence. Diagonal compensation preserves the estimated marginal noise variances, while low-rank operators enable residual Gaussian likelihood evaluation and noise transport without dense covariance storage or factorization. Factor-derived feature modulation explicitly conditions the denoiser, and a geometry-aware objective accounts for errors after noise transport. The same conditional geometry governs forward perturbations and reverse sampling. Across nine datasets, FaCoDiff achieves the lowest mean variogram score on eight datasets and ranks among the top two on 43 of 54 dataset-metric combinations in the reported comparisons. item.title: EvoOPD: Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Proprietary language models exhibit strong reasoning and coding capabilities, but their output distributions are inaccessible, making fine-grained distillation methods that rely on

Proprietary language models exhibit strong reasoning and coding capabilities, but their output distributions are inaccessible, making fine-grained distillation methods that rely on teacher logits difficult to apply directly to black-box models. We observe that rich textual feedback from a black-box teacher can be treated as privileged information (PI) and converted, through a PI-conditioned privileged teacher, into dense supervision signals on the student's own trajectories. However, what PI should be acquired from the teacher to most effectively support student learning remains unclear. PI strategies that differ in where they focus, what information they request, and how much detail they provide can have substantially different effects on the current student, and their relative effectiveness can further change as training progresses. Based on this observation, we propose Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation (EvoOPD), which treats PI acquisition itself as an optimization problem and maintains a PI Strategy Bank that evolves with the student state. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Deep generative models, particularly Flow Matching frameworks, have emerged as powerful tools for synthesizing complex physical systems. However, standard architectures remain pure

Deep generative models, particularly Flow Matching frameworks, have emerged as powerful tools for synthesizing complex physical systems. However, standard architectures remain purely statistically driven and agnostic to the underlying governing equations, often violating fundamental physical constraints during inference. Existing zero-shot approaches designed to enforce these constraints typically rely on rigid algebraic projections. While effective for sparse boundary conditions, applying such discrete geometric corrections to dense, full-domain PDEs may disrupt the probability path, \rev{potentially deviating from the learned manifold and introducing substantial computational overhead}. To address these challenges, we introduce Energy-Guided Transport, a novel training-free framework that formulates non-linear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy landscape. Rather than interrupting the ODE integration, our method applies a continuous dissipative force directly to the intermediate generative states, steering them toward the physical manifold. By evaluating this force implicitly via reverse-mode automatic differentiation, our framework preserves the natural dynamics of…

item.title: Energy Efficient Near-Threshold Voltage Massive MIMO Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：近阈值计算（NTC）可为数字电路节省高达 10x 能耗，但 PVT 变化使低电压处理器易发时序错误——大规模 MIMO 算法能否在近阈值电压下可靠运行？

方法：为常规 massive MIMO 算法配备计算错误检测机制，用低开销的基于算法的容错（ABFT）替代高开销硬件时序错误检测；开发 SPICE 晶体管级仿真与负载感知故障注入的协同仿真框架，评估 Gauss Seidel、ADMIN、Conjugate Gradient 三种检测器。

关键数字：近首失点（PoFF）时 BER 仅增加 0.7%~1.4%；ABFT 检出绝大多数算术与内存错误；64x16 MIMO 系统开销估计低于 2%，更大配置更低。能耗为解析估计、不针对特定工艺节点。

为什么值得看：算法级容错让 MIMO 计算下探近阈值电压成为可能，为基站侧节能提供新路径。

原文：Energy Efficient Near-Threshold Voltage Massive MIMO Computing
item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：近阈值计算（NTC）可为数字电路节省高达 10x 能耗，但 PVT 变化使低电压处理器易发时序错误——大规模 MIMO 算法能否在近阈值电压下可靠运行？

方法：为常规 massive MIMO 算法配备计算错误检测机制，用低开销的基于算法的容错（ABFT）替代高开销硬件时序错误检测；开发 SPICE 晶体管级仿真与负载感知故障注入的协同仿真框架，评估 Gauss Seidel、ADMIN、Conjugate Gradient 三种检测器。

关键数字：近首失点（PoFF）时 BER 仅增加 0.7%~1.4%；ABFT 检出绝大多数算术与内存错误；64x16 MIMO 系统开销估计低于 2%，更大配置更低。能耗为解析估计、不针对特定工艺节点。

为什么值得看：算法级容错让 MIMO 计算下探近阈值电压成为可能，为基站侧节能提供新路径。

原文：Energy Efficient Near-Threshold Voltage Massive MIMO Computing

item.title: Efficient Stable Word-RAM Simulation by Population Protocols
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Population protocols model computation by indistinguishable agents interacting in uniformly random pairs, with unary inputs and outputs encoded by state counts. Efficiency requires

Population protocols model computation by indistinguishable agents interacting in uniformly random pairs, with unary inputs and outputs encoded by state counts. Efficiency requires polylogarithmically many states and polylogarithmic stabilisation time, measured as interactions divided by population size $n$. Stability requires eventual stabilisation to the correct output with probability $1$; silence requires that no agent changes state after stabilisation. Fast stable leader election and majority in leaderless populations require growing state spaces. Despite progress on individual problems, the general computational power of efficient stable protocols remains largely unexplored. We show that it extends beyond semilinear predicates, which characterise constant-state stable computation. We give an efficient, stable, and silent simulation of every $\mathcal{P}$-program: a word-RAM program with running time and number of registers polynomial in $w=Θ(\log n)$. Stabilisation takes polylogarithmic time both in expectation and with high probability. The framework supports general word-oriented computations, including multiple outputs. item.title: Decouple to Reuse: Fine-Grained Knowledge Augmentation for Time Series Foundation Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Time series forecasting is critical for demand prediction and resource management in modern Web services, yet applying pretrained Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) to downstrea

Time series forecasting is critical for demand prediction and resource management in modern Web services, yet applying pretrained Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) to downstream tasks remains challenging due to domain shifts. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches typically retrieve coarse-grained window contexts and may introduce context-specific noise. To address this problem, we argue that temporal patterns should be reused at a decomposition level, as effective trend and seasonal dynamics may originate from different contexts. We propose \method, a two-stage \underline{F}ine-grained \underline{K}nowledge \underline{A}ugmentation framework that decouples and consolidates pre-training knowledge into compact, task-shared residual codebooks to enhance frozen TSFMs. Specifically, Stage I constructs dual-branch residual codebooks for decoupled trend and seasonal signals, while Stage II dynamically retrieves and merges these fine-grained patterns into target representations via task-adaptive aggregation and gate fusion. Extensive experiments across eight real-world benchmarks with four representative TSFM backbones demonstrate the superior effectiveness and computational efficien…

item.title: Data Center Agglomeration and Power Infrastructure Capacity in the United States
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

The continuous expansion of digital infrastructure, especially data centers, has imposed unprecedented, geographically concentrated stress on existing power grids. However, rigorou

The continuous expansion of digital infrastructure, especially data centers, has imposed unprecedented, geographically concentrated stress on existing power grids. However, rigorous causal evidence quantifying how these facilities reshape local power-infrastructure supply remains limited. This study builds a comprehensive county-level US panel dataset spanning 2010-2024, uniquely integrating individual data center building footprints and power-plant additions. To mitigate endogeneity and high-dimensional confounding, this study deploys Double Machine Learning with five-fold cross-fitting, conditioning on county and year fixed effects alongside regional socioeconomic covariates. Baseline estimation identifies a significant positive causal effect robust across multiple rigorous specifications. The result holds following 1%-99% winsorization that downweights mega-clusters including Loudoun County: growth in data-center floor area drives meaningful increases in nearby power-generation capacity (ATE=1.982, P=0.000, CI: [1.25, 2.72]). Outcomes remain statistically significant using a one-year lagged treatment to address reverse causality, and are stable under state-level fixed-effect alt…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DMuon: Scaling Matrix Optimizers in Data Parallelism with Topology-Aware Matrix Ownership and Communication
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Muon 这类矩阵优化器更新整块权重矩阵，与数据并行运行时按元素/行分片冲突——分片后矩阵优化器要么额外通信要么重复计算，如何扩展？

方法：DMuon 给每个矩阵分配唯一 owner 执行完整 Newton-Schulz 迭代与优化器更新，按计算成本均衡负载；HSDP 下所有权跨副本全局化，集群只保留一份梯度与优化器状态，参数就绪即跨节点发布并与后续计算重叠；集合通信稀疏变长、就绪即调度，沿两层网络路由。

关键数字：最多 256 张 H100、三个稠密 LLM 与两个 VLA 模型上，中位吞吐达 PyTorch FSDP2+AdamW 的 1.05x；相对 gather-then-replicate Muon 基线中位吞吐 2.1x。

为什么值得看：矩阵优化器在 FSDP/HSDP 上的首个规模化运行时，让 Muon 类优化器可用到大集群训练。

原文：DMuon: Scaling Matrix Optimizers in Data Parallelism with Topology-Aware Matrix Ownership and Communication

item.title: Cross-Asset Knowledge Transfer for Early Fault Detection of Data-Scarce Assets Without Target Fault Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Reliability management of industrial fleets depends on early fault warnings, yet lifecycle data across similar assets are highly imbalanced. A few assets accumulate run-to-failure

Reliability management of industrial fleets depends on early fault warnings, yet lifecycle data across similar assets are highly imbalanced. A few assets accumulate run-to-failure histories, while newly installed or rarely failing assets provide only normal-condition data. This paper asks how diagnostic knowledge can be transferred from a data-rich source asset to a data-scarce target asset when no fault data have been observed on the target. We formulate cross-asset early fault detection as a zero-shot domain adaptation problem, in which zero-shot refers to the absence of target fault samples, and propose a framework that requires only normal data from the target. The framework comprises (1) a statistical process control step that labels the source asset run-to-failure data with an exponentially weighted moving average chart, reducing manual annotation to verifying flagged segments, (2) an Adapted Domain-Adversarial Neural Network (ADANN) that combines domain-adversarial training and a Maximum Mean Discrepancy penalty with an Adapted Classification-Domain (ACD) loss, which anchors the classifier normal region to the target own normal data, and (3) an ahead-of-time labeling scheme …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Continual Classification Beyond the Kernel Regime: Harnessing the Sparsity Bias of L2 Regularization in Diagonal Linear Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

We study logistic regression for continual learning with linear predictors in a high-dimensional statistical setting. Existing theoretical work has largely focused on continual lin

We study logistic regression for continual learning with linear predictors in a high-dimensional statistical setting. Existing theoretical work has largely focused on continual linear regression with variants of L2 regularization, motivated by their analytical simplicity and connection to the kernel regime of neural networks. We first derive the optimal L2 regularization strength for continual linear classification and characterize its generalization performance, recovering behavior analogous to prior results for continual linear regression. Next, we examine the effect of L2 regularization in deeper models using a minimal two-layer diagonal linear network. In the single-task setting, L2 regularization on the weights of such models is known to promote sparsity in the resulting predictor, yielding a rich, sparse feature-learning regime beyond the kernel regime (a similar effect arises in two-layer ReLU networks). However, in continual learning, where L2 regularization is typically centered on previous-task weights, this sparsity bias is no longer preserved. We therefore propose a weighted variant of L2 regularization that extends this beneficial sparsity bias to continual learning. W…

item.title: Consistency Learning and Distillation for One-Step MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Iterative neural channel estimators can improve recovery under pilot contamination, but repeated network evaluations increase inference cost. This paper develops observation-anchor

Iterative neural channel estimators can improve recovery under pilot contamination, but repeated network evaluations increase inference cost. This paper develops observation-anchored consistency and Consistency Mid-Training (CMT) estimators for one-step channel estimation in multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. Both estimators refine pilot-derived least-squares channel estimates in the delay-beam domain. Consistency learning couples endpoint predictions along noisy-to-clean paths. CMT then refines a compact consistency-trained student to predict a flow-matching teacher's endpoint from intermediate trajectory states. Across the evaluated SNR range, the compact CMT student reduces uncoded symbol error rate (SER) by 9.6-20.2% relative to the one-step flow-matching baseline (0.44-0.98 dB in logarithmic SER reduction), while using 74.5% fewer parameters and 73.0% fewer network multiply-accumulates.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Chiron: Cache Management Empowered by LLM Intelligence for AI Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：AI 集群依赖本地缓存避免 GPU 等数据，但缓存性能取决于预取与淘汰策略是否匹配访问模式，而访问模式随工作负载与工作流阶段变化——如何无需改代码就能自适应？

方法：提出 Chiron 咨询式切换控制缓存系统：LLM 异步诊断访问模式并推荐策略，确定性 harness 把关建议、本地执行专家设计策略并返回缓存反馈供审阅；基于 JuiceFS 实现。

关键数字：在 9 个 AI 工作负载上，相比最优基线将任务完成时间降低 14.3%~41.2%。

为什么值得看：用 LLM 做策略推荐、用确定性 harness 兜底，兼顾智能与可靠，是「LLM 进系统控制回路」的务实范式。

原文：Chiron: Cache Management Empowered by LLM Intelligence for AI Workloads

item.title: Capability Gain from ISA to Shared Execution on AMD MI300A and MI250X
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：每代新 GPU 的宣传峰值指令速率，经过厂商库、应用与共享设备层层衰减后还剩多少？换新架构、上 FP8 或 2:4 稀疏值不值？

方法：定义 capability gain（特性在库/应用/共享设备层面保住的指令级加速比例），从 ISA 微基准经 hipBLASLt、hipSPARSELt 追到 LLM 推理与混合精度 HPL，再到最多 8 并发流共享设备，对比 MI300A（CDNA3）与 MI250X（CDNA2）。

关键数字：FP8 完成 8192³ GEMM 比 MI250X FP16 更快，但不融合的量化在 LLM 里变成逐层减速；2:4 稀疏在 hipSPARSELt 中最多保住约一半加速；队列共享下 FP8 的 GEMM capability gain 超过 1，但共享 LLM serving 从 FP8 毫无收益。

为什么值得看：用可复现指标量化「理论加速到真实收益」的损耗链路，给架构选型与精度采用提供依据。

原文：Capability Gain from ISA to Shared Execution on AMD MI300A and MI250X

item.title: CARE-FL: Federated Fine-Tuning of Multimodal LLMs in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：隐私敏感边缘环境中 MLLM 的领域适配需要联邦微调，但多模态数据异构、模态可用性不一、系统条件动态变化，客户端选择怎么做才高效且满足约束？

方法：提出 CARE-FL，把客户端参与建模为序列决策过程，用 Q 值分解应对大规模组合动作空间，以修正的 Double Deep Q-Learning 在线学习客户端长期效用；约束感知的 ε-greedy 在每轮延迟与带宽约束下选可行子集，配合自适应聚合控制不稳定全局更新。

关键数字：在 CrisisMMD 灾难响应任务、模拟异构无线边缘环境下，测试准确率更高且更稳，同时满足延迟与带宽约束（摘要未给具体数值）。

为什么值得看：把资源约束直接纳入联邦 MLLM 微调的客户端选择，贴近真实边缘部署条件。

原文：CARE-FL: Federated Fine-Tuning of Multimodal LLMs in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks

方法：提出 CARE-FL，把客户端参与建模为序列决策过程，用 Q 值分解应对大规模组合动作空间，以修正的 Double Deep Q-Learning 在线学习客户端长期效用；约束感知的 ε-greedy 在每轮延迟与带宽约束下选可行子集，配合自适应聚合控制不稳定全局更新。

关键数字：在 CrisisMMD 灾难响应任务、模拟异构无线边缘环境下，测试准确率更高且更稳，同时满足延迟与带宽约束（摘要未给具体数值）。

为什么值得看：把资源约束直接纳入联邦 MLLM 微调的客户端选择，贴近真实边缘部署条件。

item.title: AtomicFaaS: Offloading Side-Effect Compensation to the Serverless Platform
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) simplifies distributed application development by offloading operational concerns to the platform, but developers remain responsible for recovering fro

Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) simplifies distributed application development by offloading operational concerns to the platform, but developers remain responsible for recovering from failures. Retries require idempotent functions, which means that developers have to write complex, error-prone code that undoes or skips the already completed operations of a failed function. To address this, we propose AtomicFaaS, a platform extension that provides semantic atomicity for the external side effects of a function invocation, whether the function fails or its instance crashes, without developer-written compensation code. AtomicFaaS intercepts outbound calls and records their effects in a fault-tolerant log, from which the platform compensates leaked effects outside the failed instance. Compared with a manually implemented saga, AtomicFaaS eliminates compensation code and leaves no compensatable effects after any tested failure, while adding ~1 ms per intercepted call. Under load, it lowers the sustainable throughput of CPU-bound functions, while its latency overhead becomes negligible once calls to external services dominate the invocation time.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: An Interaction-Aware Decision Framework for FDIC-Assisted Distressed Bank Acquisitions: Empirical Evidence from the FDIC Failed-Bank Panel and the SVB-First Citizens Case
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Acquirers of failed banks weigh acquisition value, regulatory protection, risk, buyer strength, and execution difficulty jointly, because each signal's meaning depends on the other

Acquirers of failed banks weigh acquisition value, regulatory protection, risk, buyer strength, and execution difficulty jointly, because each signal's meaning depends on the others: high non-performing loans matter less when government loss sharing absorbs the losses. The proposed Spider Network Filtering Framework encodes such dependencies as four interpretable interaction rules among five dimensions, yielding graph-inspired features for a logistic model and a Pursue/Caution/Avoid decision rule. We evaluate it on 55 acquisitions assisted by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation in 2008-2024 by acquirers with a parent listed in the United States. Six financial inputs come from regulatory reports published before each failure; two deal terms, which the winning bidder knows when it bids but investors learn at the announcement, come from the regulator's press releases. The outcome, a positive three-day abnormal return around the announcement, records the market's initial reception, not realized success. Under grouped, nested cross-validation, the Spider-enhanced model reaches a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.594, against 0.615 for logistic regres…

item.title: Alleviating Limited Effectiveness and Multi-Class Collapse in Deep Graph-level Clustering
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Given a collection of $N$ graphs, graph-level clustering (GLC) seeks to partition the $N$ graphs into semantically meaningful groups, which serves as a fundamental task in analyzin

Given a collection of $N$ graphs, graph-level clustering (GLC) seeks to partition the $N$ graphs into semantically meaningful groups, which serves as a fundamental task in analyzing graph-structured data. While Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs) have become the de facto encoders for GLC, they still fail to distinguish graphs due to their neglect of global topology. On top of that, existing deep clustering frameworks suffer from severe "clustering collapse" issues, particularly in imbalanced multi-class scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose S$^3$GLC, a novel framework that integrates global topological characteristics with local neighborhood features for balanced GLC. Theoretically, we leverage the Hoffman-Wielandt inequality to construct Spectral Signature as a rigorous lower bound for graph edit distance (GED), providing a computationally efficient proxy for global topological features. We additionally propose a joint manifold-preserving sparse regression module to fuse Spectral Signature with Spatial Representation, eliminating noise while preserving the complementary information. Furthermore, to mitigate clustering collapse, we introduce a balanced clustering objecti…

item.title: A Controlled Experimental Evaluation of Configuration and Cache Architecture in LLM Serving Engines
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：多 agent LLM 应用跨请求重复大部分 prompt token，vLLM 与 SGLang 以不同粒度复用共享前缀缓存，默认部署基准显示巨大性能差距（通常归因于缓存）——但其他配置差异是否被混淆了？

方法：在 Kubernetes 上搭建可复现测试台与种子化多 agent 负载生成器，分别在厂商默认配置与对齐 chunked prefill 两种条件下对比两引擎；SGLang 两臂配置相同，作为跨独立部署的内部对照。

关键数字：默认配置下 vLLM 的中位 TTFT 最高达 SGLang 的 64x；对齐单一设置（chunked prefill）消除最大处 78% 的容量差距与 30%~67% 的延迟差距；剩余尾延迟优势为 2.4~6.4x，与缓存感知的等待请求排序一致。

为什么值得看：用受控实验拆穿「差距全归缓存」的归因，给出六条引擎对比建议，评测方法论价值高。

原文：A Controlled Experimental Evaluation of Configuration and Cache Architecture in LLM Serving Engines

item.title: Workload-Static Optical Circuit Switching For Scalable LLM Inference Decode
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

工作负载静态光电路交换：为 LLM 推理 decode 的固定通信结构一次配置电路，576 加速器规模评估

LLM inference decode executes fine-grained collectives whose latency directly limits per-user interactivity, yet scale-up fabrics are still built from electronic packet switches designed for training. We observe that, for a given model deployment and parallelization, the communication structure of decode is fixed, and propose workload-static optical circuit switching (OCS): circuits are configured once per deployment, co-designed with model parallelism and with topology-aware collective schedules that turn spare accelerator ports into fewer communication phases or higher bandwidth. We evaluate this design with GXNET, a graph-based workload emulator coupled to analytical and flit-level network models grounded in hardware measurements. In a 576-accelerator scale-up domain serving 5T-parameter MoE models with up to 5M tokens of context, all-OCS fabrics improve interactivity by up to 65% and energy efficiency by up to 119% over 4:1 oversubscribed packet-switched fabrics.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When the Consumer Is an Agent: Execution-Grounded Service-Level Agreements
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

执行锚定的 SLA：LLM agent 作为服务消费者时的完成契约，独立控制面观察 deadline 约束的服务状态谓词

Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly act as service consumers. They select operations and report whether a task is complete. In an asynchronous distributed service, an accepted call or immediate state read does not establish that the required state became observable by its deadline. We introduce execution-grounded completion contracts, which treat completion as a service-level outcome. An independent control plane observes a deadline-bound service-state predicate, admits completion, and directs recovery while the agent performs the task. We evaluate placement and deletion in a live multi-provider data service with heterogeneous models and an injected transfer delay. Across policies, some tasks that missed the deadline were accepted and some that met it were rejected. Under enforcement, accepted completions remained consistent with later observations; all included healthy tasks completed, and unresolved faulted tasks terminated as unverified. The results show that completion of these tasks can be governed by independent observation of service state rather than by the agent's self-assessment.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When do lookups beat multiplies? Choosing GEMM paths for ultra-low-bit LLMs
item.description:
发表方：Arm Community Blog　发布：2026-11-03　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：超低比特 LLM 何时该用查表 GEMM（LUT-GEMM）而非经典乘加。

要点：权重字母表足够小时，可预计算激活组的局部和、用打包权重码查表累加。决策规则四条：prefill 大 M 场景默认经典 GEMM；N 方向复用须能摊还建表成本；打包格式解码要规则（避免内循环被移位/掩码/符号修复占满）；查表+累加路径吞吐须跟得上。注意力分数因 Q/K 数据相关，不适用直接替换。

关键数字：Bitnet.cpp TL1 为 2 bpw、TL2 约 1.67 bpw、Sherry 1.25 bpw（配 3:4 稀疏）；Arm SME2 提供 LUTI2/LUTI4 查表指令与 ZT0 表。

为什么值得看：低比特推理的选型决策框架，直接指导端侧部署时内核选择。

item.title: When Strong Reasoners Join the Pool: Small Union Premiums and Costly Runaway Generations in LLM Routing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

强推理模型加入路由池：联合响应溢价实测（3.5pp）与代价高昂的失控生成

Routing benchmarks often judge a router against a hindsight oracle that counts a query as solved whenever any model's recorded answer is correct, but under stochastic decoding that oracle mixes two different objects: the clairvoyant ceiling of committing to one model per query and the premium of calling several models and keeping any correct answer. A companion study measured this premium at 3.5 percentage points (pp) for 11 small open models on MATH-500; how large it is once current reasoning models enter the pool was unknown. We measure it with a fixed-protocol, pre-committed generation on a single NVIDIA B300: all 500 MATH-500 problems, 30 seeded samples per problem, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and NVIDIA's Nemotron Nano 9B v2 and Nemotron Super 49B v1.5 (a NAS derivative of the same 70B) under vendor sampling, a 65,536-token cap, a pinned Math-Verify scorer, and an append-only attempt ledger, for 45,000 scored responses. The two reasoning models both reach 96.1% accuracy against 76.2% for the 70B baseline. The empirical product-coupling premium is 0.215-0.588 pp across all two- and three-model pools; the empirical plug-in selection headroom over always calling Nano is 1.27 pp; and r…

item.title: What Sets the Serving Speed of Looped Language Models? Measurements and Optimizations Graded by Exactness
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环语言模型每 token 多次应用同一层块，服务引擎要为每个 loop 支付每层开销；如何测量并系统优化 Ouro、Huginn-0125 这类模型的服务速度？

方法 在开源循环模型引擎中测量服务性能，把优化按"比特级一致"到"需精度检查"分级：融合所有 loop 提交、在舍入围栏后融合内核、避免死 KV 槽、复用 prefix-cache 页、打包 prefill、prefill-decode 分离（ExactLoop）等，逐项以精确性标尺验证。

关键数字 每 token 有 5689 个小内核是真实成本，舍入围栏融合使吞吐提升 1.11-1.59x 且 1014/1014 请求比特级一致；近似融合不更快且使 GSM8K 87 题丢一分（61/62 vs 64），故未采用。Huginn 默认配置比基础引擎快 1.77-3.16x，Ouro 1.65-2.15x、agent 会话 1.91-3.21x；prefill-decode 分离下 ExactLoop 最高达基础吞吐 3.3x，提交尾部从约 1 秒（基础 2.8s）降到 16ms。

为什么值得看 给循环模型服务优化建立了"精确性分级"的方法论——哪些优化无损可上、哪些要精度换速度，同类工作罕见。

item.title: What Is the Influence of Task Order in Continual Learning? An Empirical Study and Order-Aware Evaluation for Motion Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

任务顺序对持续学习的影响：声明顺序分布上的算法比较与顺序感知评估

Aggregate scores for continual learning algorithms rest on a distribution over task orders that is rarely stated. We formulate algorithm comparison as an expectation over a declared order distribution, which separates training variation from order variation, and apply it to motion forecasting with four road-layout tasks from the INTERACTION dataset, all 24 task orders, four algorithms, and three training replicates (288 runs). item.title: What Does It Mean to Remove an Edge? Intervention-Aware Fidelity for Graph Neural Network Explanations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

干预感知保真度：GNN 解释中删除边的干预语义辨析（结构删除 vs 消息抑制）

Graph neural network explanations are often evaluated via deletion fidelity, i.e., by deleting their top-ranked edges and measuring the resulting change in model output. Yet, in a message-passing GNN, "deleting an edge" does not specify a unique intervention. Structural deletion removes the edge from the graph and recomputes quantities such as degree normalization and attention, whereas message suppression leaves this structural context intact while blocking the message carried by the edge. The meaning of deletion fidelity therefore depends on what the intervention targets in the model computation. We formalize this distinction and derive sufficient conditions for exact equivalence. The two interventions coincide for additive message passing with edge-set-independent coefficients, but can diverge when aggregation depends on the presence of zero messages or when removing an edge changes the coefficients applied to surviving messages. We then construct intervention-specific edge attributions and evaluate each resulting ranking under both interventions, testing whether their relative fidelity changes with the evaluation intervention. item.title: Warpline: Binary-Level Tracing and Unified Evidence for Agentic GPU Kernel Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PF)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM agent 正成为 GPU 内核工程师，但调内核时看不到时间花在哪：硬件 profiler 只报各单元忙碌程度，不报每个 warp 的时间去向；核内 tracer 能显示但要手工放置探针并重编译，改变被测内核本身。

方法 提出 Warpline：分析二进制决定记录哪些事件，直接把探针插入二进制（无需重编译、无需手工步骤）；把 trace 与硬件 profiling 数据对齐到统一时间线。因只需二进制，可在 agent 每次修改内核（源码/IR/PTX 层）后自动为每个新版本重新生成证据，闭环优化无需人工介入。

关键数字 NVIDIA B200 上跨 Triton、CuTe DSL、CUDA C++ 的 35 个内核：中位开销 1.2%，99.9% 执行指令保持不变（现有 tracer 中位开销 1.6%-13.2%、仅保留 4.6%-32.7% 不变）；还能 trace 闭源内核。10 个 SOL-ExecBench 问题上，用 Warpline 的 agent 比裸 coding agent 与 NVIDIA KDA 花更少时间与模型请求，几何平均提速 7.69x（KDA 为 6.94x）。

为什么值得看 二进制级、免重编译的 kernel 内追踪让 agent 获得"时间去哪了"的统一证据，且不干扰被测内核，是 agentic 内核优化的基础设施级工作。
