item.title: Unifying and Beyond the Theory of Pervasive Capability Degradation in LLM Post-training SFT from Feature Interference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

LLM SFT 普遍能力退化理论的统一与超越：基于叠加特征干扰的几何理论

Pervasive Capability Degradation (PCD) refers to the phenomenon in which supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while adapting a large language model (LLM) to a target task, often erodes the general capabilities acquired during pre-training. Prevailing explanations attribute PCD to macroscopic distribution shift and therefore lack microscopic manipulability, leaving existing mitigation methods without a complete theoretical foundation. In this paper, we first develop a bottom-up geometric theory of PCD grounded in feature interference under superposition: narrow-domain SFT data disrupt the almost-orthogonal feature structure formed during pre-training, and the resulting interference drives activations across decision hyperplanes in the output Laguerre-Voronoi geometry, flipping predictions on general tasks. This theory unifies existing methods into six paradigms and reveals both the source of their efficacy and their theoretical limits. We then prove that cross-entropy under one-hot supervision cannot resolve PCD on its own, and accordingly propose the AEGIS loss, which directly constrains the drift of activation margins along all competing token directions, thereby decoupling interference …

item.title: Trustworthiness as a Measurement Structure for Task Conformance in 6G Service Chains
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PF)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

6G 服务链任务符合性的信任度量结构：按交付结果分布与契约的符合度定义可信

A 6G service crosses a chain of stages from different vendors, and its contract binds class-conditioned guarantees at the terminal interface: in the packet relay chain studied here, a priority class is owed a timely-delivery rate and a loss ceiling. We define trustworthiness as conformance of the delivered per-class distribution of outcomes to the contract and develop the measurement structure this forces. Two results fix its form: a discrepancy that treats outcomes interchangeably cannot express contract preferences, and no single expectation-valued score that determines the contracted terminal expectations can be carried from stage to stage once two or more contracted indicators remain independent at some stage. The minimal record is one signed number per independent contracted indicator, which the downstream design data carry to the terminal exactly; classical scalar trust models are the single-indicator case. The terminal deviation splits exactly into per-stage contributions. item.title: Transport along Local Annealing Paths: Wasserstein Geometry and Multimodal Sampling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Variational approaches to learning transport maps for multimodal sampling can suffer from mode collapse. One way to mitigate this problem is to learn transport along a prescribed p

Variational approaches to learning transport maps for multimodal sampling can suffer from mode collapse. One way to mitigate this problem is to learn transport along a prescribed path of intermediate distributions defined by geometric annealing. We show that annealing can take a substantial detour in Wasserstein space: when mass moves between modes, the path can be much longer than the distance between its endpoints. We further link path geometry to transport learning, showing that long annealing paths can slow population optimization, while sufficiently regular paths permit rapid convergence. Motivated by these findings, we propose componentwise annealed transport (CAT) to reduce the need for mass transfer between modes. Starting from a mode-informed mixture reference, CAT constructs an exact mixture decomposition of the target and learns separate transport maps along componentwise annealing paths. We estimate the component weights separately and show that these estimates remain consistent even when the learned flows are inexact. We also develop adaptive annealing schedules guided by transport effort. Experiments on multimodal synthetic distributions and Bayesian inference problem…

item.title: Training Specialist LLMs on Your Phone: Forward-Only Optimization via Block-Spectral Coordinates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 个人设备上的 LLM 能保住数据本地性，但内存限制其通用能力；多数用户特定任务不需要前沿模型的广度，宜把共享端上模型适配成轻量专家。然而反向传播内存代价高、用户又很少提供标注数据。

方法 提出 MobileSpec：只用前向传播训练专家，并从自动检查的任务结果学习（即 RLVR）。核心算法 FuRA-S 仅训练预训练权重列块的奇异值（block-spectral coordinates），产生的扰动在理论上与经验上都近似 RLVR 的权重变化；该更新可改写为对层输入的变换，因此无需改权重即可适配 INT4 模型。

关键数字 专家仅 1-5 MB、只更新 0.015-0.05% 的参数；手机 agent 的成功率从 6-23% 提升到 89-100%（具体任务集未在摘要中完整展开）。

为什么值得看 用前向-仅优化把"端上训练专家"做到可行：1-5 MB 专家、INT4 兼容、成功率大幅提升，是隐私友好端侧个性化的新路径。

item.title: Theoretical Analysis of Muon on Transformers for Next-Token Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Transformer 下一词预测中 Muon 优化器的理论分析：预处理阶段精确刻画最优归一化谱边际

Muon has recently shown strong empirical performance in training Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), yet its optimization dynamics remain poorly understood from a theoretical perspective. In this paper, we analyze the training dynamics of Muon for next-token prediction (NTP) in Transformers. The training procedure consists of two phases: the preprocessing phase learns the output-value component, while the main phase learns the key-query component. For the preprocessing phase, we characterize the optimization trajectory exactly and show that the normalized spectral margin is optimal after each update. For the main phase, we establish nonasymptotic convergence rates for the training loss and the normalized margin gap under softmax attention. These results suggest that Muon's update rule can help models efficiently learn which tokens matter for prediction, offering a possible explanation for its strong performance in large language model training. The learned weight structure also yields a generalization guarantee for unseen contexts. Furthermore, we validate our theoretical insights with experiments on next-token prediction tasks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Unreported Variable:Collector Selectivity in Data Placement Evaluation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PF)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

未报告的变量：数据放置评估中的收集器选择性——块选择策略决定标签价值，模拟显示 20-75% 提升的敏感性

A solid-state drive cannot overwrite data in place, so it cleans full blocks by copying out still-valid data, costing speed and lifetime. Interfaces such as NVMe Flexible Data Placement (FDP) let the host label data by expected lifetime so data dying together is stored together, and published schemes report cutting these copies by 20--75%. Those studies rarely state which blocks the drive chooses to clean. Varying only this choice in simulation, we show it decides how much a label is worth: label value peaks when the drive searches moderately for blocks holding little valid data, falls when it always takes the block with the least, and turns negative when it ignores how much valid data blocks hold. This holds in 47 of 48 synthetic configurations, and one real mail-server trace shows the same shape at about half the magnitude. Priced as spare capacity, a two-class label is worth 65% more spare when each scheme runs at its best setting, but becomes a net loss at 20% label error, typical of learned classifiers. Labels stating which data die together keep most of their value at 16 FDP handles and gain as cleaning improves. Evaluations must report the drive's cleaning policy.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Confidence Score: a New Measure on Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Across a wide range of applications, kernel measures are used to tune hyperparameters, select among candidate kernels, and assess the suitability of kernels for specific learning t

Across a wide range of applications, kernel measures are used to tune hyperparameters, select among candidate kernels, and assess the suitability of kernels for specific learning tasks. For classification, kernel measures are used to predict which kernels may produce accurate kernel classifiers. Many existing kernel measures, such as alignment to the ideal kernel, are designed to reward kernels which captures all samples from the same class as similar. While effective in many settings, this requirement is unnecessarily restrictive for classification, where classes may exhibit substantial internal structure. In this work, the "Confidence Score", a new kernel measure, is proposed. Unlike alignment-to-the-ideal kernel measures, the Confidence Score measures the alignment between an encoding of the ground truth and that ground truth projected by the kernel, allowing kernels that preserve intra-class structure to achieve high scores. Through experiments, it is demonstrated that the Confidence Score exhibits a higher correlation with classification accuracy across a variety of kernels on both real-world and synthetic datasets, compared to select other kernel measures.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 选择性激活检查点（SAC）决定哪些激活保存用于反向、哪些重算：每个选择是"峰值内存-重算时间"平面上的一点，目标是该平面的 Pareto 前沿。现有做法均未达此目标：手调策略固定单点、不随模型/批次/内核变化；PyTorch 的 SAC 按程序顺序重跑每块前向，重算反向从不读的值；torch.compile 把重算当免费或禁止，且只按字节选张量。

方法 提出 TapeSAC：在 eager PyTorch 中自动做 SAC 且不改模型前向代码。在 dispatcher 记录每块前向，反向时只重放 autograd 实际消费的值的生产者，保存一个张量即消除仅为它存在的所有生产者；规划器在单一步峰值内存限制下按实测重算成本选保存张量。

关键数字 在 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上：仅重放即比全检查点减少步时间 3.0% 与 1.7%（内存不增）；90% 设备内存限制下加入内存感知规划后增益升至 6.3% 与 13.9%。评估的手调策略落后于该内存-重算前沿，在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上直接 OOM。

为什么值得看 自动化逼近 SAC 的 Pareto 前沿，不用改模型代码即可省 6-14% 步时间且不超内存，大模型训练工程实用性强。

item.title: TAPES: Task-Aligned Joint Predictive Pretraining for Transaction Event Sequences
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

TAPES：任务对齐联合预测预训练用于交易事件序列

Transaction event sequences support diverse prediction tasks in online commerce and digital financial services. The same transaction records can yield prediction targets with different semantics, including values, changes, and relations to past events. These targets impose different constraints on history representations, but their predictability alone does not establish the downstream utility of a target set. Moreover, target-wise prediction losses do not explicitly model conditional co-occurrence among targets. To address these challenges, we propose TAPES, a task-aligned joint predictive pretraining framework for transaction sequences. TAPES constructs a finite collection of candidate target sets from admissible field-operator combinations. It selects a target set according to the downstream utility of representations learned through short joint pretraining trials under matched budgets. It then reinitializes the encoder and pretrains it on the selected targets through a joint likelihood parameterized by a shared discrete latent variable, before downstream supervised adaptation. item.title: Support Vector Machines Directly Minimise KL Divergence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Support vector machines (SVMs) are fundamentally grounded in geometric margin maximisation and currently lack a mainstream probabilistic interpretation. This keeps them theoretical

Support vector machines (SVMs) are fundamentally grounded in geometric margin maximisation and currently lack a mainstream probabilistic interpretation. This keeps them theoretically isolated from probabilistic machine learning models that are naturally comparable and combinable. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proving that the dual objectives of both support vector classification and support vector regression are exact, constrained Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimisation tasks between two Gaussian measures. We further show that this same divergence formulation recovers the exact objective function for kernel ridge regression when domain constraints are removed and $L^2$ regularisation is applied. By demonstrating that SVM duals directly minimise relative entropy, our results provide a unified information-theoretic model for standard kernel machines and lay the foundation for unifying broader kernel-based algorithms under probability theory.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Structure, Dimensionality, and Distribution Shape - What Makes Pretraining Data Transferable, and Why the Input Pipeline Decides Which
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

迁移不变原理：预训练语料的结构/维度/分布形状属性，输入变换决定哪些属性可迁移

What makes a pretraining corpus transferable? We describe a corpus by three properties: its structure, its dimensionality, and the distribution shape of each unit's values. We propose the Transfer-Invariance Principle: the same property can be irrelevant to transfer under one input transform and decisive under another, so the model's input transform, not the data modality, decides which properties can matter. To test it we build TransferForge, a generator that places a synthetic population at any prescribed structure, dimensionality, and distribution shape. KernelSynth, the synthetic prior of Chronos, cannot, because it draws independent series. When the model standardizes each input window (PatchTST on UCR), the distribution shape is inert and the structural setting governs. Synthetic pretraining then matches a real corpus of the same size and exceeds it once scaled. When the model encodes calcium fluorescence signals without normalization (POYO Plus), the shape becomes a governing constraint, and a shape-matched synthetic corpus replaces real pretraining with zero real neural activity. item.title: Software Design Patterns for Latency Measurements with eBPF in SDN Environments
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PF)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

SDN 环境下基于 eBPF 的延迟测量软件设计模式：Observer/Strategy/Factory 模式模块化可观测性

This work proposes, implements, and evaluates a modular architecture based on software design patterns applied to latency measurement in Software-Defined Networks (SDN) using the Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) and the Express Data Path (XDP). Unlike approaches that focus solely on measurement precision, this study examines how design patterns can structure observability systems in an extensible and maintainable way while preserving data-plane efficiency. The proposed architecture applies the Observer, Strategy, and Factory Method patterns to modularize the metric collection and analysis pipeline, allowing dynamic integration of policies and data sinks. The experimental environment was implemented with Mininet, Python agents, and eBPF/XDP programs, and was evaluated in terms of processing time, overhead, and evolution effort. The results show that the introduction of design patterns shows no clear evidence of measurable performance degradation, maintaining continuous measurements with a minimum of 5% overhead. The findings suggest that software engineering practices may be applied to the construction of eBPF-based monitoring and observability systems.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sketchpad: certified exact arithmetic with a small vision-language model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Sketchpad：小视觉语言模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B）的认证精确算术，有界外部工作记忆读视图

Language models are accurate on most long-arithmetic problems, but their accuracy is estimated on samples and carries no guarantee for an unseen input; tool use is exact but moves the computation outside the network. We show that exactness at all input lengths becomes a finite, checkable property of a network when each of its steps reads only a bounded view of an external working memory. In Sketchpad, Qwen3.5-0.8B with a low-rank adapter executes arithmetic procedures on a rendered sheet. Each forward pass reads a three-cell view and emits one step: a digit, a carry or borrow, and the next operation. A fixed runtime moves the view and writes no digit of a result. We prove in Lean that the model is then exact on all inputs of any length if and only if it is exact on the finite set of views the runtime presents, that no finite test suffices when steps also read earlier steps, and that the guarantee tolerates bounded numerical perturbation and extends to compositions of procedures. All 2,446 views pass on the deployment device, a laptop GPU running the model in a web browser. The certified model performs signed addition and subtraction, long multiplication and division, square roots a…

item.title: Self-stabilising approximate clock synchronisation requires linear time
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

自稳定近似时钟同步需要线性时间：消息传递系统自稳定场景的复杂度下界

Synchronising the clocks of processes is a fundamental problem in distributed computing. We consider message-passing systems in which processes start in an arbitrary initial state (self-stabilisation) and up to $f$ processes may be non-transiently faulty. It is well known that synchronising clocks \emph{exactly} is at least as hard as consensus and requires $Θ(f)$ time. In contrast, without self-stabilisation, clocks can be synchronised \emph{approximately} much faster, in time independent of the number of non-transient faults [Srikanth and Toueg, JACM 1987; Welch and Lynch, Inf. Comput. 1988]. In this work, we show that deterministic self-stabilising approximate clock synchronisation tasks require $Ω(f)$ time to stabilise. This gives the first non-trivial time lower bound for these tasks, whose time complexity has remained open for over two decades [Dolev and Welch, JACM 2004; Dolev, Függer, Schmid and Lenzen, JACM 2014]. In particular, this answers the open question whether self-stabilising approximate clock synchronisation tasks are as hard as consensus or as easy as approximate agreement [Lenzen and Rybicki, JACM 2019]. The results show that guaranteeing \emph{both} transient a…

item.title: Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning：自特权数据加权 SFT 方法

Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a key component of language model post-training, enabling effective task adaptation and serving as an important foundation for subsequent reinforcement learning. Recent methods seek to improve SFT by introducing token-level weights into the training objective, where these weights are typically derived from a model's output distribution at each token position. To better understand how such weighting schemes affect SFT, we analyze their optimization objectives and theoretically characterize the target distributions they induce. Our analysis shows that dynamic weighting methods, such as Dynamic Fine-Tuning (DFT), induce a heavily sharpened distribution, whereas static weighting methods fit a target distribution proportional to the product of the data distribution and a frozen prior. These findings suggest that static weighting provides a more stable training target, while its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the prior distribution. Building on this observation, we propose Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning (SPFT), which uses a frozen copy of the initial model conditioned on privileged information (such as ground truth for mathematical questio…

item.title: SCANO: Restoring Boundary-Condition Completeness in Sampled Meshes with a Sliced-Cross-Attention Neural Operator for 3D Thermal Fields
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

SCANO：切片交叉注意力神经算子恢复采样网格边界条件完整性

Training neural operators on million-cell meshes can exceed GPU memory limits. Models are therefore trained on subsamples and deployed on whole meshes or selected regions. However, subsampling can distort boundary information, degrading accuracy. We ask when boundary conditioning under sampling stays consistent with whole-mesh training, and how to aggregate and inject boundary data. Representing the solution as an integral of boundary data against type-dependent measures, we show that subsampling distorts this conditioning in three ways: incomplete boundary coverage or a sample-dependent global state, face weighting by count rather than area, and compression of boundary inputs into a low-dimensional vector. This analysis yields four measurable consistency conditions checkable before training. We satisfy them with two backbone-agnostic modules. Boundary Quadrature Attention (BQA) aggregates all boundary faces, typed and area-weighted, into slice tokens that every query point reads at every layer. Anchored Global State (AGS) estimates the global state from anchors independent of the sampled points. Adding both to a scalable message-passing and slice-attention backbone yields SCANO. W…

item.title: Runway Characters: Serving a 57B Video Diffusion Transformer for Real-Time Conversation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：会话式视频角色必须按播放速度生成视频（24fps 下单用户、batch size 1 时每四帧块需持续 166.7ms、仅几块缓冲）——Runway Characters 如何在四张 H100 上实时服务约 57B 参数的视频扩散 Transformer？

方法：把每块 240 次注意力调用中的整缓存重复工作移到写时完成（ring cache、RoPE 与 FP8 量化写一次、位置重置时 delta 旋转），把张量并行 all-reduce 融合进 FP8 GEMM（in-switch reduction），并给潜变量转视频帧的解码器独立 GPU。

关键数字：无融合 kernel 时扩散步从 240.9ms 降到 159.3ms（1.51x，稳定 24.5fps）；融合 kernel 达 147.4ms（1.63x，FP8 峰值 43%）；lip-sync 分数无退化。

为什么值得看：首个以 24fps 实时服务 57B 视频扩散模型的系统级方案，缓存写时化与通信融合思路可迁移到其他流式生成场景。

原文：Runway Characters: Serving a 57B Video Diffusion Transformer for Real-Time Conversation

item.title: Rethinking Abstractions in the Agentic Era: Towards a DSL and Compiler Foundation for Agentic Kernel Development
item.description:
发表方：Apache TVM Blog　发布：2026-11-03　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：Agent 已能自动开发高性能 GPU kernel（B200 kernel 显著超越现有基线），ML 编译器从业者被迫重问根本问题：我们还需要编译器吗？答案是需要，但形态要变。

要点：Agent 不受人类认知局限约束，可直接用低层 CUDA/PTX、秒级读剖析报告、一小时内探索上百 kernel 变体；但若让每个 agent 每次迭代都重新发明 IR 与编译基础设施，代价巨大。作者主张提供一个最小、稳定的 ML 编译器基座作为共享抽象与可复用工具，把优化探索留给 agent；并以此理念从零重建 TIRx，定位为 agentic kernel 开发的共享 DSL 与编译器基础。

关键数字：正文未给出量化基准数据；案例来自社区既有工作（KernelAgent、CUDA Agent、CAKE、TIRx Harness 等）。

为什么值得看：Apache TVM 社区对「agent 时代的编译器抽象」的正面回答，直接关系到 kernel 开发工作流的未来形态。

原文：Rethinking Abstractions in the Agentic Era: Towards a DSL and Compiler Foundation for Agentic Kernel Development

item.title: Replica-Aware Split Inference for Edge IoT Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 拆分推理（Split Inference）把 TinyML 模型段分布到多个 IoT 设备解决资源限制，但设备故障会中断推理流水线，如何在故障后快速恢复？

方法 提出 replica-aware 恢复方案：把原故障设备上的 TinyML 模型段副本部署到存活设备。将副本宿主选择与通信协议选择联合建模为混合整数线性规划（MILP），在 Flash 与运行时内存约束下最小化重配置后的推理延迟（含计算与传输延迟）。

关键数字 在 15 台 IoT 设备、最大链路速率下降 75% 的网络中（MobileNetV2）：MILP 方案的平均建模端到端推理延迟比 Computation Greedy 低 6.8%、比 Random 低 18.3%。

为什么值得看 面向 TinyML 边缘推理的故障容错专项工作，把"副本放哪、用哪种协议"做成可求解的联合优化问题，对 IoT 可靠推理系统有工程参考价值。

item.title: Recasting Visual Language Models as EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Neurodiagnostics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Historically automated electroencephalography (EEG) systems was done using task-specific supervised models trained on purposely annotated data. A more recent modeling paradigm reli

Historically automated electroencephalography (EEG) systems was done using task-specific supervised models trained on purposely annotated data. A more recent modeling paradigm relies on creating a unified representation, or a 'foundation model', for multiple modality-specific tasks through large-scale domain-specific pretraining on the unannotated EEG signal. The quality of this unified representation directly depends on the availability of the modality-specific datasets. At the same time, generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) exhibit broad few-shot learning capacities as well as good fine-tuning adaptability to different visual and language tasks. Can VLMs learn how to read and interpret EEG visually, emulating to a degree the way human clinicians inspect the EEG patterns? In this work we make a case that they can: we show that generalist VLMs without large-scale EEG pretraining perform competitively across a collection of clinical neuro-diagnostic tasks, can adapt to different tasks in a few-shot learning setting better than specialist foundation models, and exhibit better performance with model scaling when modality-specific models fail to exhibit.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: RGDM: Robust Graph Diffusion Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

RGDM：鲁棒图扩散模型，从对抗损坏图学习鲁棒生成器

Diffusion models represent a powerful class of generative models known for their solid theoretical foundations and remarkable performance across diverse tasks and domains. Existing node level diffusion methods synthesize nodes and edges within a graph, but are not designed to learn a robust generator from adversarially corrupted graphs. In this study, we introduce the Robust Graph Diffusion Model (RGDM), designed to generate labeled synthetic graph structures consisting of nodes and edges that integrate seamlessly into a given graph. The RGDM consists of a Robust Graph Autoencoder (RGAE) and a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM). Leveraging an edge selection mechanism and an innovative low-rank regularization on the latent feature, the RGDM produces clean and high-quality synthetic graph structures, even when trained on graphs subject to adversarial attacks. Comprehensive experimental evaluations reveal that Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) trained on the augmented graph, which is formed by merging the original attacked graph with the synthetic graph structures, exhibit significantly improved robustness against various graph adversarial attacks in the context of semi-supervised node classific…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Proving the Wrong Program: Miscompilations as a Threat to zkVM Guarantees
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PL)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

证明错误的程序：误编译对 zkVM 保证的威胁——生产 zkVM 上误编译的首次实证研究

A zero-knowledge virtual machine (zkVM) lets an untrusted prover convince a verifier that a program, typically Rust compiled to RISC-V, ran correctly. The proof covers the compiled binary, so a miscompilation can make a correct zkVM produce a valid proof of a computation that differs from the developer's source. We present the first empirical study of miscompilation as a threat to zkVM guarantees, on the production zkVMs SP1 and Jolt. We assemble 88 known rustc and LLVM miscompilations with Rust reproducers, using an LLM agent to recover Rust triggers for 60 of 124 LLVM bugs reported only as LLVM IR. Many of the bugs carry over to zkVMs: 48 of the 88 make a guest commit a wrong output on SP1 and 46 on Jolt, including the same 15 rustc bugs on both. Most bugs that do not reproduce never reach the faulty code on the zkVM's target, e.g. because they need an instruction-set extension. Existing guest programs are rarely affected by accident. Across 13 guests of 10 popular SP1 projects, the buggy and the fixed compiler produce byte-identical binaries in 447 of the 552 guest-bug pairs that build, and the other 105 have the same code or agree on every input we ran. An attacker who contribu…

item.title: Provably Learning Mixtures of Linear Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

可证明学习线性专家混合：首个门控 MoE 梯度训练收敛保证

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely deployed in modern machine learning. However, few convergence guarantees exist for gradient-based training of MoEs: the objective is nonconvex, and even simple mixtures trap first-order methods in spurious local optima. We analyze a canonical gated mixture featuring linear experts and a gate induced by Gaussian clusters in the input space, and give, to our knowledge, the first global convergence guarantee for jointly training the gate and the experts of such a model by gradient EM on its likelihood. Given a logarithmic overparameterization relative to the true number of experts $m$, gradient EM converges from randomly initialized gates and least-squares-initialized experts to any prescribed accuracy in polynomially many iterations, under a separation condition on the gate centers. Our analysis establishes a gradient-dominance inequality for the coupled dynamics by decoupling the loss into per-cluster subproblems. Empirical results validate the predicted $m\log m$ phase transition and suggest that the least-squares warm start required by our analysis is not needed in practice: randomly initialized experts perform nearly as well. We also fin…

item.title: Privacy for Free in Efficient Agnostic Halfspace Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

高效不可知半空间学习中免费隐私：首个高效差分隐私算法

We provide the first computationally efficient, differentially private algorithms for agnostically learning halfspaces. In particular, we study three different settings of agnostic learning: improper learning under Gaussian and log-concave marginals; proper learning under Gaussian marginals; and semi-agnostic learning under Gaussian marginals. In all three aforementioned settings, the added cost in the sample complexity due to privacy matches the respective non-private sample complexity, implying that we get privacy for free.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Post-Inference Model Chaining: A Problem Statement and a Model-based Bootstrap for Training End-to-End Digital Twins
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

推理后模型链：端到端数字孪生的问题陈述与基于模型的 bootstrap 训练

End-to-end digital twins can be constructed by fitting separate stage models and connecting them after inference. We investigate the Frequentist prediction properties of a commonly used Monte Carlo simulation scheme that forwards complete predictive draws through such a chain when measured stage outputs contain independent normal errors, but the latent stage means are deterministic. Analytical two-stage examples show persistent asymptotic interval and coverage inflation and, with quadratic propagation, mean bias dependent on the parameters to be estimated. Simulations of four- and eight-stage linear-quadratic univariate chains with 7, 15 or 30 training runs demonstrate pronounced input-dependent distortions. A diagnostic using error-free latent training predictors shows that the effect is mainly not attributable to errors in variables, but to the MCSim approach even showing underestimation of coverage. We propose a model-based bootstrap: an initial chain forwards fitted means, bootstrap chains are refitted on fixed-center bootstrap data while forwarding their mean prediction, and a target-stage future error enters a studentized prediction root. Across the investigated scenarios, re…

item.title: Policy Network Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

DPPG：扩散模型生成策略网络参数，检验生成策略的泛化能力

Diffusion models have shown remarkable progress in AI-generated content, including images and videos. In this paper, we explore whether diffusion models can generate the parameters of policy networks in reinforcement learning (RL), and whether the generated policies exhibit generalization capabilities. To achieve this, we propose Diffusion-based Conditional Policy Network Parameter Generation (DPPG), which consists of a Transformer-based autoencoder and a task-conditioned diffusion model. The autoencoder achieves a high compression rate by patchifying network parameters, while the task-conditioned diffusion model generates corresponding parameters conditioned on different environments. Our experiments demonstrate that, with a single unified DPPG model, we can synthesize high-quality policies across a diverse set of tasks from different environment domains, including Classic Control, Atari games, and MuJoCo. Additionally, our method can generate networks with a larger number of parameters compared to previous approaches. Furthermore, we find that in previously unseen environments, DPPG can generate parameters that achieve faster convergence and reach competitive performance, showcas…

item.title: PhotonZip: Lifecycle-Aware Compression for HDF5-Based Synchrotron Workflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

PhotonZip：面向 HDF5 同步辐射工作流的生命周期感知压缩框架，按压缩率或吞吐选择编码模式

Synchrotron detectors generate data at rates that challenge storage and I/O systems. Compression can reduce data movement, but codec-only measurements do not capture the end-to-end behavior of HDF5 workflows. We present PhotonZip, a lifecycle-aware compression framework that tests candidate modes through a common HDF5 path and selects among eligible measured configurations according to either compression ratio or round-trip throughput. Its modular filters preserve standard HDF5 access when the required plugin is available. Across four beamline-derived datasets, PhotonZip reaches lossless compression ratios up to 1.629$\times$ and HDF5 write throughput up to 3.40GB/s write and 7.75GB/s read. The throughput-oriented configuration achieves 1.529$\times$ lossless data reduction while improving HDF5 write and read throughput by 21.2\% and 15.0\%, respectively. Lossy preview modes provide up to 16$\times$ data reduction and reduce preview latency by up to 8.35~s in the evaluated file-per-rank HDF5 configuration.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Parallel Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics in Python: Task- and Data-Parallel SINDy with Numba, OpenMP, Threads and Multiprocessing for the Lorenz and Rössler Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Python 中 SINDy 稀疏非线性动力学识别的任务/数据并行实现：Numba+OpenMP+线程+多进程四后端

The sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) recovers interpretable governing equations from time-series data by sparse regression over a library of candidate functions. As data sets, candidate libraries and the number of repeated fits grow, the cost of SINDy becomes dominated by the evaluation of the library matrix and its least-squares problems. We present an open-source Python implementation of SINDy in which a single set of loop-based kernels is just-in-time compiled with Numba and executed on a shared-memory multicore node by four interchangeable back ends: Numba prange, OpenMP directives through PyOMP, Python threads that release the global interpreter lock, and multiprocessing with shared memory. The normal equations are accumulated in one cache-blocked pass over the data, with an automatic fallback to a tall-skinny QR reduction for ill-conditioned problems. Two decompositions are studied on the Lorenz and Rössler systems: an ensemble (task-parallel) workload of 960 independent identifications and a library (data-parallel) workload of one trajectory with $2\times10^7$ samples and a fifth-order library of 56 candidate terms. All back ends recover the exact sparsity…

Python 中 SINDy 稀疏非线性动力学识别的任务/数据并行实现：Numba+OpenMP+线程+多进程四后端

The sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) recovers interpretable governing equations from time-series data by sparse regression over a library of candidate functions. As data sets, candidate libraries and the number of repeated fits grow, the cost of SINDy becomes dominated by the evaluation of the library matrix and its least-squares problems. We present an open-source Python implementation of SINDy in which a single set of loop-based kernels is just-in-time compiled with Numba and executed on a shared-memory multicore node by four interchangeable back ends: Numba prange, OpenMP directives through PyOMP, Python threads that release the global interpreter lock, and multiprocessing with shared memory. The normal equations are accumulated in one cache-blocked pass over the data, with an automatic fallback to a tall-skinny QR reduction for ill-conditioned problems. Two decompositions are studied on the Lorenz and Rössler systems: an ensemble (task-parallel) workload of 960 independent identifications and a library (data-parallel) workload of one trajectory with $2\times10^7$ samples and a fifth-order library of 56 candidate terms. All back ends recover the exact sparsity…

item.title: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. Although prior work reports near-perfect in-dis

Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. Although prior work reports near-perfect in-distribution (IND) distillation performance, we find that this can mask incomplete capability consolidation beyond the supervised distribution. A preliminary study on synthetic reasoning shows that OPD does not fully transfer teachers' generalization capabilities. We then extend this investigation to real-world tasks, evaluating extrapolative and compositional generalization across mathematical reasoning, coding, agent, and long-context capabilities using Qwen3 models. Across extrapolative settings, OPD and MOPD reach 96.04-102.73% of their teachers' IND scores. Yet their out-of-distribution (OOD) scores remain 2.45-16.25% below the base model's. Across three compositional settings, MOPD improves IND performance over the base model, but its performance on composed tasks as OOD remains 18.19-24.34% below that of the best teachers. To understand these gaps, we examine teacher capability and data coverage as two potential bottlenecks. Jointly alleviating these bottlenecks eliminates OOD forgetting in our experi…

item.title: Nordic Semiconductor Combines Wi-Fi and Edge AI in nRF71 Chips
item.description:
发表方：Nordic Semiconductor / Unite.AI　发布：2026-11-03　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 Nordic Semiconductor 2026 年 11 月 3 日发布 nRF71 系列低功耗芯片，面向电池供电设备，在单芯片上集成 Wi-Fi、BLE、Thread、应用处理器与边缘 AI。

要点 首批型号 nRF7120/nRF7120E 将 Wi-Fi + 2.4 GHz 多协议射频 + 主处理器合一，取代此前 nRF70 系列"Wi-Fi 伴芯"需外挂主控的架构，简化设计、减少板面积与器件数；内置 Axon NPU 支持端侧推理，TWT 与低功耗接收器默认启用以压低连接态功耗。

关键数字 待机功耗较 nRF70 系列低 20 倍；2.4 GHz 连接态平均电流 14 μA、5 GHz 为 8 μA（DTIM 10）；Axon NPU 推理比 Cortex-M33 快 10-17 倍。

为什么值得看 与用户关注的 NORDIC 平台评估直接相关：单芯片 Wi-Fi+AI 方案对低功耗边缘唤醒/传感类产品是重要选型参考。

item.title: Non-Interfering Asymmetric AdamW Updates for Constrained Exploration of Equifinality in Hybrid Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

非干扰非对称 AdamW 更新：混合模型中等终性约束探索

Hybrid models let neural networks supply the unresolved parameters of a process-based simulator, and are fitted to observations that constrain aggregate fluxes and storages but not the internal partitioning that produces them. Such a fit is equifinal: configurations indistinguishable in the observed aggregates can disagree substantially about the unobserved internals, and therefore about the mechanism they attribute to the same data. We study evapotranspiration, whose total flux is observed while its split into transpiration and evaporation is not. A model ensemble built from random seeds alone spans only a narrow band of the partitionings the data admit. We produce the spread deliberately, training members under auxiliary repulsion on transpiration, subject to the fit to observations not degrading. Non-interference is usually arranged by making the auxiliary gradient orthogonal to the main one, but under AdamW the applied step is a preconditioned momentum direction, so orthogonality between raw gradients no longer implies it. We introduce Non-interfering Asymmetric Network Optimization (NANO), an update whose first-order effect on the main loss is exactly that of the main objectiv…

item.title: Multi-Objective Generative Optimization via Expected Hypervolume Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

期望超体积微调：多目标生成优化的对齐方法

Scientific discovery requires plausible designs spanning useful trade-offs among competing properties: a molecule with strong binding affinity, for example, may be difficult to synthesize. Pretrained generative models, e.g., flow and diffusion generators, provide a foundation for proposing such designs, but steering them toward high-quality, complementary trade-offs remains challenging. Inference-time search incurs high per-sample costs, while fine-tuning typically relies on fixed per-candidate rewards that do not capture how designs complement one another. We introduce Hypervolume Fine-Tuning (HVFT), which adapts a single pretrained generator to maximize the expected hypervolume of its samples while controlling departure from the pretrained distribution. Expected hypervolume jointly rewards candidate quality and collective trade-off coverage. Nonetheless, we show that it cannot be expressed as the expectation of a fixed per-candidate reward and therefore cannot be optimized directly with standard techniques. A key observation of this work is that its first variation corresponds to the expected marginal hypervolume contribution of a candidate, which yields a tractable adaptive rewa…

item.title: Modulating Merging Strengths via Joint Loss Estimation for LoRA-based Continual Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

M2LE：联合损失估计调制 LoRA 持续学习合并强度，Hessian 引导自适应合并

Continual learning (CL) aims to adapt models to new tasks while preserving previously learned knowledge. Recently, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a representative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) method, has gained increasing attention in CL due to its efficiency and scalability. Several LoRA-based merging methods maintain a single inference model by scaling the newly learned LoRA update with one coefficient and merging it into the previous weights after each task. However, they usually control the whole update with a shared scalar factor, although different update elements may affect previous and current tasks in different ways. To address this issue, we propose Merging Strength Modulation via Joint Loss Estimation (M2LE). It consists of Hessian Information-guided Adaptive Merging (HIM) and Task Simulation Perturbation for Merging (TSP). Instead of searching for a global merge coefficient, HIM directly solves for the target merged update under a joint objective over previous and current tasks. Solving this objective gives an analytic solution that naturally takes the form of element-wise modulation over the current task LoRA update. To improve the stability of the learned updat…

item.title: ModelBlaster: Closing the Performance Gap through Learning-Augmented Agents Across Models, Kernels and Hardware Backends
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 跨硬件架构优化加速器代码很难：ML 编译器在预定调度/微内核空间搜索，LLM 引导优化可探索新算法与硬件技巧，但现有 LLM agent 通常只针对单一编程接口/工具链/加速器族、只做内核级不做模型级优化、跨硬件经验复用有限。

方法 提出 ModelBlaster，Memory-Augmented In-Context RL（MAIC-RL）框架：可变策略是持久知识库，推理时由 Actor-Critic Textual Gradient Descent（AC-TGD）更新；知识库把性能状态映射到动作/结果/约束，实现跨内核、模型、硬件目标的经验复用；模型级优化器用内核级知识指导整模型决策。同一优化循环与知识模式支持 NVIDIA CUDA、Qualcomm OpenCL、RISC-V RVV，仅 lowering 与测量层按目标特化。

关键数字 相对 PyTorch：KernelBench Level 1/2/3 几何平均提速 1.85x/5.58x/5.18x，SOL-ExecBench Level 1/2 提速 1.69x（B200 GPU）；Qualcomm Adreno GPU 上亦有显著提升（具体数值摘要未给出）。

为什么值得看 把"跨硬件可迁移的学习型内核/模型优化"做成统一框架，一次优化经验在 CUDA/OpenCL/RVV 间复用，是 agentic 编译方向的大一统尝试。

item.title: Minimizing Bottleneck Overload Risk in Online Edge Task Placement under Workload Uncertainty
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

工作量不确定下在线边缘任务放置的最小化瓶颈过载风险：按服务器残差容量吸收波动分配任务

In edge computing, tasks must be placed on servers of finite capacity before workloads are realized, often with only workload means and variances known. An assignment balanced on expected load can still leave a server with more fluctuations than its residual capacity can absorb. Per-server risk constraints can enforce a prescribed overload tolerance but do not distinguish the assignments that meet it by how close the riskiest server comes to the limit. We show that, for independent tasks, placement preserves a period's total variance and total residual capacity, and decides only how fluctuation, measured by standard deviation, is paired with residual capacity across servers. The risk ratio, the ratio of fluctuation to residual capacity, parameterizes a server's worst-case overload probability over all aggregate workload distributions with given mean and variance. We minimize the largest risk ratio, attained at the risk bottleneck. Risk-Bottleneck Placement (RBP) places tasks in descending order of standard deviation, each on the server with the smallest post-assignment risk ratio, and refines the assignment with relocations and swaps within a finite per-period online budget. item.title: Memory-Access Profiling for Early Multicore Interference Awareness in Embedded Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：多核处理器上不同应用经共享资源相互干扰，导致执行时间波动；在硬件详尽测试之前，能否尽早感知这种缓存相关的多核干扰？

方法：提出早期多核干扰感知的剖析框架：以少量源码改动捕获 C 应用的源级内存操作轨迹，结合目标平台架构参数，把内存访问映射到 cache set 与内存块，生成缓存占用剖面与热图，并经粗筛、静态多核缓存剖析、时间足迹分析三阶段渐进评估成对干扰风险。

关键数字：双核平台上四组基准配对验证，与硬件计数器观测的高低风险情形一致；不同应用配对可使 L2 缓存缺失最多增加 213.09%。

为什么值得看：在穷尽式硬件测试前提供可解释的早期干扰指标，对嵌入式多核系统的集成与分区有实用价值。

原文：Memory-Access Profiling for Early Multicore Interference Awareness in Embedded Systems

item.title: Matched but Not Better: An Equivalence-Tested Benchmark of Quantum Machine Learning on Six Clinical Datasets and the QML-Health-READY Reporting Framework
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compa

Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compared a quantum-kernel support vector machine (QSVM; 4 qubits, tuned bandwidth) and a variational quantum classifier (VQC) with five tuned classical models across six public clinical datasets. All models used identical four-component inputs and 25 cross-validation splits. Paired AUROC differences were assessed using a corrected resampled t-test, Holm-adjusted equivalence tests (margins: +/-0.02 and +/-0.05), and random-effects pooling. Ablation, noise, finite-shot, and implementation-fault analyses were conducted. We propose QML-Health-READY, an eight-domain reporting framework. Results: Neither quantum model significantly outperformed any classical comparator. Pooled across datasets, QSVM differed from the kernel-matched radial basis function (RBF) SVM by -0.006 AUROC (95% CI: -0.017 to +0.004), equivalent to +/-0.02. VQC differed from the best classical model by -0.007 (95% CI: -0.019 to +0.004). QSVM was equivalent to RBF SVM within +/-0.05 in four of six datasets but was significantly worse than the bes…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

宏正则生成器网络：匹配多尺度统计的数据高效物理模拟神经代理

Many scientific simulations are computationally expensive, limiting their use in simulation-based inference, uncertainty quantification, and decision making. We introduce macrocanonical generator networks, a framework for learning fast, data-efficient neural surrogates for amortized simulation of stationary physical processes by matching multiscale statistics of a target process. Inspired by microcanonical maximum-entropy synthesis, which matches feature statistics per sample by inner-loop optimization, our approach instead trains a neural generator to satisfy the same constraints in expectation, preserving physically realistic sample-to-sample fluctuations. item.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环 Transformer 每 loop 步各存自己的 key/value，KV cache 随 loop 步数线性增长成为主要内存瓶颈；同时各 loop 步对量化的敏感度差异大。

方法 提出 LoopVQ：沿 loop 轴联合编码多个 loop 步的通道，并微调码本以匹配全精度模型输出。与现有面向标准 LLM 的 KV cache 向量量化方法正交，可组合使用。

关键数字 0.5 bits/元素时，在通用、长思维链推理、长上下文检索任务上（Ouro 与 Huginn 模型）超越现有 KV cache 向量量化方法；与 TaSQ 组合在 0.25 bits/元素仍保留大部分 BF16 精度。SGLang 实现中，32K token 上下文解码延迟近乎减半，1.4B 与 2.6B Ouro 模型峰值服务吞吐相对 BF16 基线最高提升 4.3x 与 6.1x。

为什么值得看 首次把子 1-bit KV 量化做到循环模型上，利用 loop 轴冗余实现近半解码延迟削减，吞吐提升显著。

item.title: LoopKV: Loop-Aware KV Cache Compression for Serving Looped Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环（looped）Transformer 每 token 多次应用共享块，如 Ouro 每 loop 保留独立 KV cache，cache 内存限制批量大小；统一比特量化与固定规则无法按各层在各 loop 的敏感度分配精度。

方法 提出 LoopKV：一次性离线 profile 为每个 (loop, layer) 单元选择 4-bit 存储、2-bit 存储或复用最终 loop 的 KV；规划器在预测损伤与存储预算下最小化读取。解码时每个 loop 读 4-bit 值的高 2 位，仅在其注意力权重需要 4-bit 精度处取回低 2 位；vLLM 中单一融合内核执行该计划。

关键数字 单张 RTX PRO 6000 服务 Ouro-1.4B：内存优化版 LoopKV-M 比统一 4-bit 量化（KIVI-4）在同一融合内核与 CUDA graph 上少存 35% KV；16K token 上限、延迟 SLO 下 goodput 达 KIVI-4 的 1.7-2.2x；六个公开基准平均均未显著低于 BF16。

为什么值得看 把 KV 压缩从"全局统一"推进到"逐 loop 逐层定制"，直面循环模型特有的精度-内存权衡，并已集成 vLLM。

item.title: Local Distributed Computation under Crash Failures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

崩溃容错下的本地分布式计算：一致邻域视图支持崩溃场景局部模拟无故障算法

We study deterministic algorithms for locally checkable graph problems in the synchronous LOCAL model with crash failures, where a crashing node may send messages to only some neighbors. We introduce consistent neighborhoods: partial radius-$R$ views that agree locally across surviving edges and are complete without crashes. For $R=T+\ell+1$, these views allow local simulation of $T$-round fault-free algorithms that remain correct on subgraphs, satisfying constraints wherever the radius-$\ell$ checking neighborhood contains no crash. On graphs with at most $n$ nodes and maximum degree at most $Δ\geq3$, we construct these views in $O(\min\{n,(Δ-1)^R,RΔf\})$ rounds when a crash bound $f\geq1$ is globally known; the first two bounds require no knowledge of $f$. For $Δ=2$ or girth greater than $2R$, including forests, $O(R)$ rounds suffice. Our upper bounds are essentially tight in suitable parameter regimes. One crash can force $Ω(n)$ rounds even for $R=3$ on diameter-two graphs. For each fixed $Δ\geq3$ and sufficiently large $R$, we prove a $(Δ-1)^{R-O(\sqrt R)}$ lower bound even with crashes restricted to round beginnings. item.title: LiquidCP: Decoupling Attention Tasks from Communication and Kernel Boundaries in Context Parallelism
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 上下文并行（CP）把长序列切分到多 GPU 做训练/推理：变长训练与全 prefill 下注意力均衡放置会致 token 负载不均，ring 执行在每个计算/通信步重复开销；stage 串行 decode CP（DCP）中长任务阻塞依赖工作、GPU 空闲。

方法 提出 LiquidCP，用统一的 Transfer/Compute/Reduction 任务模型（带 tile 级依赖）解耦注意力任务与通信、内核边界。训练与全 prefill 用 MegaRing：BuddyRing 放置均衡注意力与 token 负载，前向注意力中合并就绪 KV 区域摊薄开销；decode 与混合批次用 MegaDCP：联合建模注意力及其依赖归约的完成来选 history-KV 切分。共享持久 GPU 常驻引擎执行两种设计。

关键数字 8x H100 上相对各配置最快基线：MegaRing 核心注意力几何平均提速前向 1.23x、反向 1.18x，Transformer 层加速 1.08-1.16x；MegaDCP decode-only 1.20x、混合批次 1.35x；vLLM + KV prefix cache 下平均 TTFT 提速 1.22x。

为什么值得看 统一了训练与推理的 CP 执行模型，把注意力从通信与内核边界中解放出来，是序列并行执行的最新系统化方案。

item.title: Linking as Evaluation: Correct Separate Compilation via First-Class Environments
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PL)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

以链接作为求值：通过一等环境实现正确的分离编译（λ_SCE 演算）

Separate compilation is central to modular software: components are compiled independently and linked into an executable. Separate compilation is correct when a linked program behaves like the program formed by merging its sources. This property is less routine to prove than type soundness because it requires a formal account of linking. We present $λ_{\mathsf{SCE}}$, a simply typed calculus in which linking, modules, and environments are all first-class. Programmers control module linking through a link operator, which a type-directed elaboration translates into ordinary terms of a core calculus of first-class environments. The core calculus's existing evaluation rules then perform the linking: linking as evaluation. Linking independently compiled modules yields the same core term as elaborating their source link. Therefore, compilation and linking commute by construction. As a result, separate compilation correctness follows directly from the semantics preservation for both static and dynamic linking. All meta-theory is mechanized in Lean 4, and we implement a compiler to WebAssembly in OCaml.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: LeanSparse: Memory-Efficient Serving for Native Sparse-Attention LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏注意力限制了每个 query 读的历史，但长上下文服务仍占用大量 GPU 内存：现有 KV offloading 系统在 GPU 上保留完整 indexer key 历史，限制 decode 并发；prefill 的临时内存需求还会在内存本够用时延迟请求准入。

方法 提出 LeanSparse（SGLang 实现）：利用两个观察——prefill 逐层消费历史数据、decode 可在比较原始 indexer 分数前先识别候选。prefill 阶段让层历史流经两个可复用 GPU 缓冲，与模型计算重叠；decode 阶段用粗到细索引搜索紧凑表示，仅对候选细化才取回原始 indexer key；indexer key 与 KV cache 分离并跨生成步复用。

关键数字 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、950K 上下文：并发请求数为 HiSparse 的 2.95x、decode 吞吐 2.14x；多轮 Open-SWE 轨迹上中位首 token 时间从 21.6s 降至 0.6s，中位会话完成时间相对 ECHO 降低 17.7%。

为什么值得看 同时压 decode 持久内存与 prefill 临时内存两块瓶颈，在 950K 超长上下文上取得近 3 倍并发提升，工程落地价值高。

item.title: LENS: Reliability-Aware Stock Prediction via LLM-Extracted Priors and News-Driven Semantic Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

LENS：LLM 提取先验+新闻驱动语义图的可信度感知股票预测 GNN

Predicting stock returns requires modeling persistent company relations and time-varying market signals. Graph Neural Network (GNN) approaches combine static priors with dynamic relational graphs, but treat every extracted edge as a trustworthy binary fact, ignoring heterogeneous reliability across relational sources. We propose LENS (LLM-Extracted priors and News-driven Semantics), a static--dynamic graph framework for stock return prediction and ranking that models relational reliability as a first-class signal across the pipeline. On the static side, we extract a multi-relational company graph from a Large Language Model and aggregate it over multiple runs with confidence weighting to downweight low-consistency edges. On the dynamic side, we build a news-driven semantic graph with exponential-decay temporal aggregation to capture changing market context under uneven coverage. A context-dependent gated fusion module rebalances the two graphs at the per-stock, per-day level. On S&P 500, LENS improves AR@5 by 16.4% and SR@5 by 22.6% over the strongest baseline, and on NASDAQ 100 it achieves comparable improvements (15.5% and 20.9% respectively). item.title: LACS: Distribution-Sensitive Label-Agnostic Confidence Selection for Dynamic Data Pruning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Training on large datasets motivates selecting which examples receive expensive training computation. Fixed quotas determine the amount of pruning in advance, while absolute confid

Training on large datasets motivates selecting which examples receive expensive training computation. Fixed quotas determine the amount of pruning in advance, while absolute confidence cutoffs depend on the score scale. We study a population-relative alternative that adapts the threshold and retained count together. We introduce LACS (Label-Agnostic Confidence Selector), a training-time rule based on maximum predictive confidence, requiring neither labels at selection time nor per-example gradients. LACS removes examples at or above a log-mean-exp reference plus a margin. We characterize its sensitivity to score gaps and mass, and derive an exact no-pruning condition. For $0<ρ<1$, the removed fraction is at most $ρ$ and at least one example remains. The unsigned score permits both confidently correct and confidently wrong examples to be removed. Seven evaluation settings include neural training, language modeling, and boosting. Neural execution studies reduce backward-active rows by 10-35%; on CIFAR-10, 29% fewer backward rows accompany accuracy means of 89.77% versus 89.82% for full CE. At a matched backward budget and number of optimizer updates, LACS is 1.0 pp above small-batch …

We study a population-relative alternative that adapts the threshold and retained count together. We introduce LACS (Label-Agnostic Confidence Selector), a training-time rule based on maximum predictive confidence, requiring neither labels at selection time nor per-example gradients. LACS removes examples at or above a log-mean-exp reference plus a margin. We characterize its sensitivity to score gaps and mass, and derive an exact no-pruning condition. For $0<ρ<1$, the removed fraction is at most $ρ$ and at least one example remains. The unsigned score permits both confidently correct and confidently wrong examples to be removed. Seven evaluation settings include neural training, language modeling, and boosting. Neural execution studies reduce backward-active rows by 10-35%; on CIFAR-10, 29% fewer backward rows accompany accuracy means of 89.77% versus 89.82% for full CE. At a matched backward budget and number of optimizer updates, LACS is 1.0 pp above small-batch …

item.title: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Koopman 生成算子：高效概率时间序列预测的生成框架

Probabilistic time-series forecasting requires models that simultaneously capture structured temporal dynamics, expressive uncertainty, and efficient inference, yet existing approaches fall short of this goal: latent dynamical models impose structure but rely on restrictive generation mechanisms, while modern generative methods such as diffusion and flow matching achieve flexibility at the cost of iterative and computationally expensive sampling. We introduce the Koopman Generative Operator (KGO), a probabilistic forecasting method that conceptualizes prediction as the evolution of structured uncertainty. KGO integrates three core components: (1) Koopman Patch Embedding (KoPE) for temporally consistent latent trajectory extrapolation; (2) Koopman Flow Matching (KoFM), which enables fast, single-step generation through a closed-form matrix exponential in a Koopman latent space, bypassing iterative sampling; and (3) an Adaptive Uncertainty Gate (AUG), which provides probabilistic forecasts by adapting uncertainty per-variable and per-horizon, corresponding to a learned decomposition of aleatoric uncertainty without manual tuning. By unifying these components, KGO achieves state-of-th…

item.title: HyPAIC: Personal AI Computer with High Bandwidth Flash for High Performance Trillion-Parameter LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 万亿参数 MoE LLM 本地部署需求增长，但现有 PAIC（个人 AI 计算机）用 LPDDR 统一内存，容量受限：权重占满内存后 KV cache 空间所剩无几，支持上下文长度大打折扣。

方法 提出 HyPAIC 架构：把只读模型权重放 HBF（高带宽 Flash），可变运行时数据放 LPDDR。HBF 容量超 HBM 10 倍以上、带宽达 TB/s 级。针对 HBF 的访问延迟、有限写耐久与页级访问粒度，分别用预取、只读权重放置、粗粒度权重访问应对。

关键数字 模拟评估：单个 HyPAIC 在 1T 参数 MoE 推理中端到端吞吐最高提升 1.04x、TDP 归一化吞吐最高 3.59x（对比八个无 HBF 基线系统的合计）——一个 HyPAIC 接近八个基线的原始性能且能效远优；小模型推理下并发任务数（每任务保持 ≥50 decode TPS）最高提升 4x。功耗与散热仍是显著实现挑战。

为什么值得看 用 HBF 打破 PAIC 的内存容量天花板，一个人工智能电脑逼近八台设备的聚合性能，是本地万亿参数推理的硬件新路线。

item.title: Ground-Wing: A Parametric 3D Wing-in-Ground-Effect Dataset for Benchmarking Neural Surrogate Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Ground-Wing：翼地效应 3D 机翼参数化 CFD 数据集（770 次 RANS），用于神经代理模型基准

This paper presents a CFD dataset of a highly parametrized 3D wing operating in ground effect, designed for benchmarking neural surrogate models for aerodynamic prediction, using a wing shape and flow conditions typically encountered in motorsport applications. The dataset comprises 770 RANS simulations of 194 unique wing configurations, sampled across 27 airfoil profile variants and 4 distances from the ground, spanning variations in wing sweep, chord, taper, angle of attack, and tip twist. Six neural network architectures representing distinct paradigms --- convolutional (DoMINO), graph-based (X-MeshGraphNet), transformer-based (AB-UPT, GeoTransolver, GAOT), and JEPA-based (AeroJEPA) --- are evaluated on their ability to predict surface pressure coefficient and wall shear stress distributions, from which integral drag and lift coefficients are recovered. The dataset is intended to be used as a challenging benchmark for surrogate CFD models, due to the uniqueness of the ground effect being absent from other wing and airfoil datasets.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Give the Drafter a Second Chance to Guess: Parallel Reconsideration for Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：推测解码靠小 draft 模型加速 LLM 推理，但特征级 drafter 对每个 token 只做一次前向猜测，被目标模型拒绝的往往是 drafter 自己也没把握的 token——能否给这些犹豫的猜测二次机会？

方法：提出 Parallel Reconsideration：drafter 依据自身不确定性，用与单遍 draft 并行运行的额外前向来重新考虑犹豫的猜测，几乎不增加延迟；配合共同设计的训练配方与 serving 期草拟算法，把重估猜测作为精炼候选追加到原 draft 树。

关键数字：跨模型与基准平均，接受长度相对基线提升 5.3%~10.2%，加速比提升 3.5%~9.2%。

为什么值得看：用 drafter 的不确定性信号做并行二次猜测，零额外延迟换可观加速，是推测解码低垂果实的进一步挖掘。

原文：Give the Drafter a Second Chance to Guess: Parallel Reconsideration for Speculative Decoding

item.title: Generative AI Comes to Embedded: Powered by Arm Ethos-U NPU
item.description:
发表方：Arm Community Blog　发布：2026-11-03　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：生成式 AI（扩散模型）能否跑在 MCU 级硬件上。

要点：经 PyTorch→ExecuTorch→CMSIS 流程，把 pico-faces（约 1.7M 参数的 latent rectified-flow 扩散 transformer）部署到 Alif Ensemble E8：Ethos-U85 NPU 执行 transformer 与图像解码器，Cortex-M55 CPU 控制 4 步扩散采样与 classifier-free guidance；16×16×8 latent（2048 值）替代直接生成 49152 像素，量化按组件区分精度。

关键数字：参考运行约 78ms 生成一张 128×128 RGB 人脸（4 步扩散×CFG=8 次 transformer 调用+1 次解码）；对比 Pico 2 CPU 版约 8 秒/张。

为什么值得看：端侧生成式 AI 的完整落地方案与量化/内存/CPU-NPU 分工实践，MCU 级图像生成成为现实。

原文：Generative AI Comes to Embedded: Powered by Arm Ethos-U NPU

item.title: GSPIM: A Temporal-Locality-Aware 4DGS Accelerator for PIM-Enabled Edge Devices
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 4D 高斯泼溅（4DGS）实现动态场景实时新视角合成，但显式分布、关键帧插值等方法的 GPU 数据搬移存在两个瓶颈：时间过滤发生在模型记录加载之后，浪费 LPDDR5 带宽；逐帧独立执行忽略相邻帧间高度重叠的活动集与深度关系，工作集超片上缓存时反复重载共享属性。

方法 提出 GSPIM，面向 PIM 边缘设备的时序局部性感知 4DGS 加速器：多态 PIM 用共享近存数据通路适配各表示的字段布局与选择流程，在 GPU 访问完整属性前过滤压缩有效数据；多帧渲染数据流在时间窗口内复用活动属性与稳定深度关系；混合数据流调度让近存数据准备与 GPU 渲染重叠。

关键数字 结合 Jetson AGX Orin 64GB 校准的 GPU-PIM 模型与 1z DRAM 物理实现：跨 3 种 4DGS 方法、6 个动态场景，相对逐帧 GPU 基线几何平均提速 4.15x、能效提升 4.99x；场景级 PSNR 最大差 0.011 dB，附加物理面积 18.7172 平方毫米（32 个 LPDDR5 die）。

为什么值得看 面向边缘 XR/自动驾驶的 4DGS 专用加速器，用近存处理解决动态场景渲染的数据搬移瓶颈，物理实现细节完整。

item.title: GC-MoE: Overlapping Expert-Parallel Token Dispatch with FP8/FP4 Grouped GEMM via CUDA Green Contexts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 专家并行（EP）下 MoE 每层都要做 all-to-all token dispatch、grouped GEMM 与 combine；decode 时每 rank 仅 1-256 token，dispatch 延迟与权重流量主导、张量核利用率天然很低。现有融合算子（如 DeepGEMM Mega MoE）让 dispatch 与计算共享每个 SM 的资源预算与同步域，互相争抢。

方法 提出开源 GC-MoE（NVIDIA Hopper/Blackwell 的 FP8/FP4 MoE 推理算子）：用 CUDA Green Contexts 把设备分成小的通信分区与大计算分区，各自拥有独立内核、资源预算与同步域；三节点 CUDA Graph（Hopper 上加融合共享专家为四节点）并发启动 dispatch 与 grouped-GEMM，token-ring 握手在首批 ring 块填满时即开始计算，双缓冲接收计数器去掉 replay 间尾部跨 rank barrier。

关键数字 8x H20 上 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode 平均加速 1.188x（峰值 1.296x/1.353x）；8x B300 上 GLM-5.2 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 加速 1.106x（融合共享专家 1.123x，峰值 1.209x），54 个测量点全部超过 Mega MoE。

为什么值得看 用 Green Context 硬件机制从根上隔离 dispatch 与计算资源，公开开源，是 MoE decode 推理算子优化的新范式。

item.title: ForgeKernel: Self-Evolving Kernels Catching and Surpassing Experts and Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 现有 GPU kernel 生成 agent 缺少跨运行知识积累与架构演化：每次从同一初始知识开始，后期迭代基本在搜索早期固定下来的架构内优化。

方法 提出 ForgeKernel：跨运行积累并复用知识，同时持续演化内核架构。它分析高性能参考实现的硬件行为，把经验证有效的架构决策蒸馏为"硬件机制"层面的可复用知识（而非模仿源码）；通过正确性与性能验证的内核被密封，作为下一轮优化的参考，使架构决策可被重访。

关键数字 在 NVIDIA Hopper/Blackwell 的 27 个算子、29 种输入配置上，25 个配置持平或超过专家参考，几何平均性能提升 10%；Ascend 910C 上在 CANN-Bench Season 1 终榜全部 8 个 level-4 算子超越逐算子公开最佳，几何平均提升 25.1%；截至 2026-10-30 其公开提交在三个 CANN-Bench 2.0 榜单与 SOL-ExecBench FlashInfer-Bench 全部排名第一。

为什么值得看 把内核生成从"单次搜索"升级为"自我进化的知识系统"，并跨 NVIDIA/Ascend 多硬件验证，代表 agentic 内核优化的重要进阶。

item.title: FenixWalk: Adaptive Sampling for Large-Scale Dynamic Graphs on Heterogeneous Architectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

FenixWalk：异构 CPU-GPU 上大规模动态图的适应性采样，权衡采样效率/更新开销/内存

Random walks are fundamental to graph analytics, yet executing them efficiently on large, evolving graphs remains challenging. Existing approaches must balance sampling efficiency, update overhead, and memory consumption. Sampling structures optimized for throughput often incur substantial memory overhead and costly maintenance, whereas lightweight alternatives can suffer from high sampling latency on high-degree vertices or skewed weight distributions. These challenges become more pronounced on heterogeneous CPU--GPU platforms, where host memory provides capacity but GPU memory limits the amount of graph data that can benefit from parallel acceleration. We present FenixWalk, a memory-efficient random-walk system that combines unified in-place sampling with selective GPU acceleration for large-scale dynamic graphs. At its core, FenixWalk employs an in-place Fenwick representation that supports both rejection sampling and inverse-transform sampling without duplicating edge-level weight storage. This representation enables expected O(1) weight lookup for rejection sampling, together with O(log d) prefix sampling and updates. To exploit heterogeneous hardware efficiently, FenixWalk ma…

item.title: Federated Transfer Learning for Medical Image Classification under Mixed Skew
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

混合偏斜下医学图像分类的联邦迁移学习

Deep learning in medical imaging is constrained by data scarcity and by privacy regulations that make centralizing patient data across institutions impractical. Federated Learning (FL) addresses these constraints by keeping data local, but its distributed nature exposes training to strong statistical heterogeneity. Multicentric medical data is particularly affected, exhibiting a mixed skew that combines feature, label, concept, and quantity shifts across centers. Personalized FL mitigates heterogeneity by tailoring a model to each client, yet most methods assume training from scratch, which is unrealistic given the high dimensionality of medical features relative to the limited data available. We propose the Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained (PAFP) framework, a personalized FL approach built on a pre-trained backbone. PAFP inserts client-specific Feature Alignment modules before the fine-tuned blocks to realign hidden feature distributions toward a server-aggregated target. On the FedISIC benchmark, PAFP attains the highest unweighted balanced accuracy while reducing inter-client performance variance roughly six-fold relative to the strongest baseline, yielding accuracy and…

item.title: FedSharp: Byzantine Robust Decentralized Federated Learning Under Noisy Channel
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Decentralized federated learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server but remains vulnerable to data heterogeneity, Byzantine attacks, and channel noise. We show that no

Decentralized federated learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server but remains vulnerable to data heterogeneity, Byzantine attacks, and channel noise. We show that noise accumulates as models propagate across nodes, becoming increasingly significant as the learning rate decays. Moreover, accumulated noise enables Byzantine attackers to exploit loss-based model selection by mimicking honest model averages. To address these challenges, we propose screened, hop-aware, ranked, proximal averaging, a robust DFL framework (FedSharp). In this approach, each node maintains models from its 2b predecessors, ensuring at least b honest candidates when at most b nodes are Byzantine. FedSharp screens suspicious models using coordinate-wise median deviations, averages the b lowest-loss candidates to reduce fresh channel-noise variance by a factor of b, and applies noise-adaptive gradient-norm regularization and proximal training to mitigate accumulated noise and non-IID drift. Experiments on a 100-node ring with 33 Byzantine nodes show that FedSharp achieves 93.5-94.9% accuracy on MNIST, compared with 29.4-38.1% for a state-of-the-art single-model-selection benchmark, and 32.8-48.8% …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

FedCSGA：基于遗传算法的联邦学习客户端选择，适配异构边缘计算

Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of machine learning models across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. In practical deployments, FL relies on selecting a client subset in each communication round to reduce communication cost, mitigate stragglers, and improve training efficiency under heterogeneous data and system conditions. In heterogeneous edge computing environments, both statistical heterogeneity and system heterogeneity significantly affect convergence efficiency and model performance. However, existing client selection methods often address these factors independently, overlooking their coupled and dynamic impact across communication rounds. To address this limitation, we propose FedCSGA, a Client Selection method for Federated learning based on Genetic Algorithm. FedCSGA encodes client subsets as chromosomes and evaluates these subsets through a non-linear fitness function that jointly integrates resource-aware metrics and history-aware participation weighting. This design captures subset-level interactions, mitigates persistent selection bias, and balances statistical utility with system efficiency. Extensive experiments on FMNIST, CIFAR…

item.title: Fault-tolerant shallow recurrent decoders for sparse sensing with missing sensor measurements
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

容错浅层循环解码器：缺失传感器测量的稀疏感知状态重建

Real-world sensing systems are inherently imperfect: sensors may fail, intermittently disconnect, operate with asynchronous sampling rates, and be subject to noise, leading to measurement streams that are irregular, incomplete, and heterogeneous. Nevertheless, sensing strategies for real-time state reconstruction typically assume synchronous and continuously active sensors, a constraint that substantially limits their applicability in operational environments. In this work, we introduce fault-tolerant sparse sensing strategies in the context of shallow recurrent decoders (SHRED) to enable high-dimensional state estimation from sparse, asynchronous, and missing sensor measurements. Specifically, we consider naive imputation strategies, fault-tolerant recurrent temporal encoders, and we introduce four different transformer-based masking mechanisms to make SHRED explicitly aware of sensor availability through the binary data-availability mask. Moreover, we further introduce a multi-step decoding training objective for SHRED, resulting in smoother latent trajectories and more robust predictions. item.title: Exploiting Biases in Attention for Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

利用注意力偏差：给 query-key 点积加输入相关偏置，显式化 token 绝对重要性

Attention is known to be sparse in vision transformers. In particular, we analyze the unequal relevance of attention-matrix columns to the final computation and show that this phenomenon becomes increasingly pronounced with network depth. This can be interpreted as saying that tokens have an absolute importance for the attention process, independently of queries. Inspired by this, we propose a reformulation of the attention formula that makes this phenomenon explicit by adding an input-dependent bias to the query-key dot product. We show that this new term gives each token a scalar value indicating its anticipated influence on other tokens during the attention process, and can thus serve as a proxy for pruning attention maps. Across multiple transformer model sizes, this allows us to substantially reduce the computational cost of attention, in terms of both FLOPs and inference latency, while retaining most of the original classification accuracy. We publicly released the code and models at https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/AttentionWithBias.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Exact Selective Inference for Spectral Clustering via Piecewise-Constant Graph Perturbation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

谱聚类的精确选择性推断：分段常数图扰动下的条件检验

Cluster labels are often used twice: first to discover groups, and then to test whether the discovered groups differ. This double use of the data makes ordinary two-sample $p$-values anti-conservative. Selective inference fixes this by conditioning on the clustering event, but for spectral clustering the event appears difficult because the algorithm combines an affinity map, an eigendecomposition, and a rounding step. We show that, for spectral clustering based on unweighted $\varepsilon$- or $k$-nearest-neighbor graphs, the obstruction is the affinity construction rather than the eigendecomposition. Along the one-dimensional perturbation used by the truncated-$χ$ selective test, graph changes occur only at finitely many real roots of data-dependent quadratic distance comparisons. Between these breakpoints, the graph, Laplacian spectrum, embedding, rounding, and reported cluster pair are deterministic functions of a finite graph state. Consequently, in real arithmetic and under a known-scale spherical Gaussian model, the selection set is an exact finite union of intervals, yielding finite-sample selective $p$-values for selected spectral-cluster pairs. item.title: EvoCache: Accelerating Browser Large Language Model Delivery with Public Cache Anchors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

EvoCache：浏览器 LLM 交付加速，用公共缓存锚点无损重建各发布方模型文件，避免重复下载数百 MiB 权重

Large Language Models (LLMs) can run directly in a browser, but first use typically requires downloading model files that are hundreds of MiB or even several GiB in size. The same LLM is often repackaged by different publishers; these files share substantial content, yet byte differences prevent whole-file caches from reusing them. We propose EvoCache, a browser-managed LLM delivery system. EvoCache uses public cache anchors that are stored in advance by the browser and independent of browsing history to reconstruct losslessly the publisher version requested by a site. A site specifies only the target, while the browser selects the anchor and performs reconstruction, keeping both hidden from the site. An audit of 1,000 public repositories finds that 61 of the 100 most popular LLMs are offered by multiple publishers and that 98.1% of overlapping versions cannot be reused by whole-file caching. Across 23 cross-publisher model-package pairs, EvoCache achieves a median traffic reduction of 77.3% and outperforms every comparator. Across 240 real end-to-end browser experiments, EvoCache reduces network traffic by 78.9% and page-ready time by 64.2% relative to ordinary full downloads. For…

item.title: EvoCG: Self-Evolving Precision Control for Faster Conjugate Gradient
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

EvoCG：强化学习策略在线选择逐 tile 精度的混合精度共轭梯度求解器，配 Tile-CSC 统一混合精度 SpMV kernel

Modern GPUs offer far higher throughput in low precision than in FP64, but exploiting this in conjugate gradient (CG) solvers is difficult because tolerance to reduced precision evolves with the Krylov state. We present EvoCG, a mixed-precision CG solver that treats tile-wise precision as an online control action rather than a fixed setting: a reinforcement-learning policy in the iteration loop selects per-tile precision from the evolving solver state, made profitable by co-design with a Tile-CSC unified mixed-precision SpMV kernel and a low-overhead in-loop runtime. Across 47 SPD matrices from eight scientific domains, EvoCG is the fastest solver overall, with geometric-mean speedups of 2.52x, 3.06x, 2.48x, 1.93x, and 6.99x over cuSPARSE, PETSc, Ginkgo, Mille-FP64, and Mille-Mixed. On the same substrate, it improves time-to-solution over EvoCG-FP64 by 1.28x at only 11.4% more iterations and 1.09% overhead, with FP64-recomputed final true-residual norms nearly identical to those of FP64, and extends to Jacobi-preconditioned CG without retraining, yielding a further 1.15x geometric-mean speedup over EvoCG-FP64.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Energy-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 强化学习的生成与训练阶段对 GPU 需求不同，存在降频省电空间；但响应长度多变、试频本身耗时耗能，在线选频很难——能否自动完成？

方法：提出 EE-RL 在线控制器，为 RL 执行中的生成与训练分别选择频率；与默认 GPU governor 在同一 token 负载上的预测比较候选设置，保留满足吞吐阈值的最省电配置，并随负载变化持续监控调整。

关键数字：H100 与 GB200 固定频率扫描显示每个有效训练 token 的 GPU 能耗最多省 28.2%；EE-RL 在线把收益兑现为最多 16.9% 的能耗下降，吞吐代价很小。

为什么值得看：把 RL 训练两阶段的硬件需求差异变成可在线利用的节能空间，是面向推理/训练一体节能调度的实用方案。

原文：Energy-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models

item.title: Empirical Bayes Flow Matching for Continuous Cryo-EM Heterogeneity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

经验贝叶斯流匹配：连续 cryo-EM 异质性的生成先验学习

We address the problem of learning generative priors over high-dimensional latent variables from indirect, noisy observations, with a focus on continuous heterogeneity in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM). In this setting, 3D atomic structures $x \in \mathbb{R}^{3N_a}$ are never directly observed and must be inferred from 2D projection images $y$ generated by a complex, non-linear forward operator. We propose Empirical Bayes Flow Matching (EB-FM), a method that learns a flow matching prior $p_θ(x)$ directly from observations using a Monte Carlo stochastic approximation Expectation-Maximization framework. EB-FM alternates between an E-step that performs approximate posterior sampling from $p_θ(x \mid y)$ via guided flow-based generation while maintaining persistent latent estimates through stochastic approximation, and an M-step that updates the flow model using these stabilized latent variables as training targets. This approach eliminates the need for pretraining on clean data and naturally accommodates non-linear forward models. We validate our method on controlled inverse problems using two-moons and MNIST data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on simulated cryo-EM data with k…

item.title: Easy Multi-Precision Acceleration via Vectorization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：高层编程语言 + 加速器支持多样数值精度与更高带宽，但能否只靠简单向量化编码就拿到接近硬件峰值的性能，跨精度、跨硬件世代保持可移植？

方法：用把运算表达为高层矩阵数学的向量化编码技术，对带宽、实数/复数矩阵乘与 2D 卷积等示例程序，在跨度近十年的多代硬件上系统评测各精度下的性能可达性。

关键数字：在内存带宽、双/单/半精度实复矩阵乘、FFT 2D 卷积上均接近硬件峰值；还发现以计算强度换内存强度的算法有显著潜力。

为什么值得看：证明「高生产力 ≠ 低性能」——简单向量化就能从高层语言环境触达近峰值性能，对性能可移植编程有直接指导意义。

item.title: Dual-VaDE: Efficient and Robust Prototype Learning via Variational Dual-Domain Mixture Priors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Dual-VaDE：变分双域混合先验的高效鲁棒原型学习

In this paper, we propose Dual-VaDE, an unsupervised generative framework for learning interpretable anatomical prototypes from unlabeled medical images. In contrast to previous variational methods that rely on a single spatial latent code, which often entangles global geometry with local textures and fails to capture their cross-domain dependencies, Dual-VaDE introduces a dual-domain Gaussian mixture prior that explicitly couples spatial anatomy with phase-preserving Fourier spectral representations. We derive an exact, closed-form variational lower bound that fuses this joint prior into the decoder and optimizes the entire network end-to-end via an alternating EM formulation, avoiding heuristic two-stage clustering while ensuring superior training stability and robustness. Evaluated on OASIS-3 brain MRI, Dual-VaDE delivers substantially sharper and more plausible prototypes, achieves superior cluster separation with improvements of up to 94% over spatial-only baselines, exhibits markedly reduced variance across random seeds, and incurs negligible inference overhead (0.28 ms per image).

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
